profile.description: MTR Corporation Limited, established in 1975 and based in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong, is a diversified global enterprise that designs, builds, operates, maintains, and invests in railway systems. Its extensive geographical reach includes operations in Hong Kong, Australia, Mainland China, Macao, Sweden, and the United Kingdom. The company's business model is structured around several key areas: Hong Kong-based transport operations, commercial activities at Hong Kong stations, property rental and management in Hong Kong, and property development within Hong Kong. It replicates similar railway and property development, rental, and management initiatives in Mainland China and other international markets, alongside various other ventures. MTR's transport services feature domestic and cross-boundary railway lines, airport express routes, and an integrated light rail and bus feeder network, overseeing an expansive infrastructure comprising 266.3 kilometers of track and 98 stations. Beyond its core transportation function, the corporation extends into intercity railway services and maximizes commercial opportunities within its facilities by leasing advertising, office, retail, and parking spaces, in addition to providing telecommunication and bandwidth services. A significant aspect of its operations is its property segment, where MTR actively invests in, develops, manages, and leases a broad array of properties, including prominent shopping centers and office complexes, complemented by estate management services. Furthermore, MTR is instrumental in the construction, operation, and ongoing maintenance of mass transit railway systems. It also manages the widely utilized Octopus contactless smartcard common payment system and offers specialized railway consultancy and project management expertise. The company supports professional development through railway management, engineering, and technology training, and administers the MTR Academy. Its comprehensive service offerings also include station management, financial and technical assistance, and the provision of mobile and fixed telecommunication network services. Expanding into leisure and tourism, MTR operates a cable car system and an associated theme village.

report.description_zh: 香港鐵路有限公司於一九七五年成立，總部設於香港九龍灣，是一家多元化的全球企業，負責設計、建造、營運、維護和投資鐵路系統。其業務範圍廣泛，包括在香港、澳洲、中國內地、澳門、瑞典和英國的營運。該公司的業務模式圍繞幾個主要領域：香港的交通營運、香港車站的商業活動、香港的物業租賃和管理，以及香港的物業發展。它在中國內地和其他國際市場複製類似的鐵路和物業發展、租賃和管理項目，以及各種其他業務。港鐵的交通服務包括本地和跨境鐵路線、機場快線，以及綜合輕鐵和巴士接駁網絡，管理著由二百六十六點三公里軌道和九十八個車站組成的龐大基礎設施。除了其核心運輸功能外，該公司還擴展到城際鐵路服務，並透過租賃廣告、辦公室、零售和停車空間，以及提供電訊和頻寬服務，最大限度地利用其設施內的商業機會。其營運的一個重要方面是其物業部門，港鐵積極投資、開發、管理和租賃各種物業，包括著名的購物中心和辦公大樓，並輔以物業管理服務。此外，港鐵在建造、營運和持續維護大眾運輸鐵路系統方面發揮著重要作用。它還管理廣泛使用的八達通非接觸式智能卡通用支付系統，並提供專業的鐵路諮詢和項目管理專業知識。該公司透過鐵路管理、工程和技術培訓支持專業發展，並管理港鐵學院。其全面的服務還包括車站管理、財務和技術援助，以及提供流動和固定電訊網絡服務。港鐵還擴展到休閒和旅遊領域，營運纜車系統和相關主題村。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 香港鐵路有限公司展現出多個強大的經濟護城河特徵，主要源於其在香港及其他地區的鐵路營運和綜合物業發展模式。其在關鍵基礎設施領域的獨特地位、廣泛的網絡效應以及高轉換成本，為其提供了顯著的競爭優勢。監管許可和地理位置優勢進一步鞏固了其市場地位。然而，對於管理層的資本配置質量和誠信的具體判斷，由於缺乏直接的質性證據，本評估主要基於公開的業務描述和財務數據進行推斷。本評估中的所有分數均為人工智慧的質性判斷，而非經審計的財務衡量標準，且可能存在證據局限性。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: MTR Corporation Limited exhibits several strong economic moat characteristics, primarily stemming from its railway operations and integrated property development model in Hong Kong and other regions. Its unique position in critical infrastructure, extensive network effects, and high switching costs provide significant competitive advantages. Regulatory licenses and geographical advantages further solidify its market position. However, specific judgments regarding the quality of management's capital allocation and integrity are inferred from public business descriptions and financial data due to a lack of direct qualitative evidence. All scores in this assessment are AI qualitative judgments, not audited financial measurements, and may be subject to evidence limitations.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 作為香港主要的公共交通營運商，港鐵擁有強大的品牌認知度和信任度。其在多個地區的廣泛營運和綜合服務，使其在客戶心中建立了可靠和便捷的形象。儘管票價可能受監管，但其在物業和商業活動中的品牌影響力，可能賦予其一定的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: As a primary public transport operator in Hong Kong, MTR possesses strong brand recognition and trust. Its extensive operations and integrated services across various regions have established an image of reliability and convenience among customers. While transport fares may be regulated, its brand influence in property and commercial activities likely grants it some pricing power.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 鐵路系統的設計、建造、營運和投資本質上需要政府的許可和特許經營權。港鐵在香港及其他國際市場的廣泛鐵路網絡，表明其享有重要的監管保護和獨家營運權，這構成了進入市場的巨大障礙。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The design, construction, operation, and investment in railway systems inherently require government licenses and concessions. MTR's extensive railway network in Hong Kong and other international markets indicates it benefits from significant regulatory protection and exclusive operating rights, which form substantial barriers to entry.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 對於香港的日常通勤者而言，港鐵的廣泛網絡和八達通支付系統已深度融入其生活，轉換至其他交通方式的成本極高。此外，其物業租戶也可能因地理位置和服務整合而面臨較高的轉換成本。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: For daily commuters in Hong Kong, MTR's extensive network and the Octopus payment system are deeply integrated into their lives, making the cost of switching to alternative transport methods very high. Furthermore, its property tenants may also face elevated switching costs due to location and service integration.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 港鐵的鐵路網絡越廣泛，連接的車站和商業設施越多，其對用戶的價值就越大。八達通系統的普及也強化了這種網絡效應，吸引更多用戶和商業夥伴，形成良性循環。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The more extensive MTR's railway network, and the more stations and commercial facilities it connects, the greater its value to users. The widespread adoption of the Octopus system also reinforces this network effect, attracting more users and commercial partners, creating a virtuous cycle.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 作為一個大型的綜合性鐵路和物業企業，港鐵在採購、維護和營運方面可能享有顯著的規模經濟。其龐大的基礎設施和多樣化的業務，有助於分攤固定成本，實現成本效益。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: As a large, integrated railway and property enterprise, MTR likely benefits from significant economies of scale in procurement, maintenance, and operations. Its vast infrastructure and diversified businesses help spread fixed costs, leading to cost efficiencies.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 港鐵在香港的核心鐵路基礎設施及其沿線的物業發展，佔據了極其優越的地理位置，這些資產幾乎無法複製。這種獨特的「鐵路加物業」模式，使其在市場中擁有不可替代的地位。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: MTR's core railway infrastructure in Hong Kong and its integrated property developments along the lines occupy extremely prime geographical locations, making these assets virtually irreplicable. This unique 'railway plus property' model grants it an irreplaceable position in the market.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 港鐵透過其綜合業務模式，包括交通營運、物業租賃和管理，以及商業機會最大化，展現出對營運效率的重視。其在多個地區的營運經驗和專業知識，有助於維持穩定的營運表現。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: MTR demonstrates a focus on operational efficiency through its integrated business model, which includes transport operations, property leasing and management, and maximizing commercial opportunities. Its operational experience and expertise across multiple regions contribute to maintaining stable operational performance.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 港鐵的戰略資產，特別是其在香港及其他地區的綜合鐵路和物業發展模式，因其龐大的規模、複雜的協調和政府支持，極難被其他競爭者複製。這種模式的不可複製性，為公司提供了長期的競爭優勢。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: MTR's strategic assets, particularly its integrated railway and property development model in Hong Kong and other regions, are extremely difficult for competitors to reproduce due to their immense scale, complex coordination, and government backing. The irreproducibility of this model provides the company with a long-term competitive advantage.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 作為香港主要的公共交通工具，港鐵對客戶具有高度的必要性。其廣泛的網絡、便捷的服務和八達通系統的整合，使得客戶對其服務的依賴性強，難以轉向其他選擇。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: As a primary public transportation provider in Hong Kong, MTR is highly essential to its customers. Its extensive network, convenient services, and integration with the Octopus system create strong customer reliance on its services, making it difficult for them to switch to other options.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 關於管理層的誠信和資本配置質量的具體證據，在提供的資料中並不明顯。雖然公司業務模式具有內在的耐久性，但缺乏直接的質性信息來評估管理層在長期價值創造方面的決策。
m10_durability.comment_en: Specific evidence regarding management integrity and the quality of capital allocation is not apparent in the provided information. While the company's business model possesses inherent durability, there is a lack of direct qualitative information to assess management's decisions concerning long-term value creation.

profile.description: Midea Group Co., Ltd. and its various subsidiaries are a global powerhouse, engaged in the production and distribution of both household appliances and advanced robotic and automation technologies across China and internationally. Its operations are strategically organized into four key divisions: HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning), Consumer Appliances, Robotics and Automation Systems, and a diverse "Others" category. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of offerings, including residential and commercial air conditioning units, comprehensive heating and ventilation solutions, kitchen essentials, refrigerators, washing machines, and numerous small household devices. Beyond consumer goods, Midea also supplies elevators, variable frequency drives, medical imaging equipment, and advanced robotics and automation systems. Furthermore, Midea is a significant provider of vital core components, such as compressors, electric motors, semiconductor chips, valves, reducers, automotive parts, and sophisticated motion control and automation technologies. They also produce high and low-voltage variable frequency drives, energy storage units, and cooling modules, distributed under established brands like GMCC, Welling, CLOU Electronics, HICONICS, SERVOTRONIX, MR, MOTINOVA, MSCT, TOSHIBA, and SUNYE. The group extends its expertise to provide integrated building solutions and is involved in cutting-edge industrial robotics, automated logistics systems, and transmission technologies designed for advanced manufacturing environments. Midea delivers specialized solutions for sectors like healthcare, entertainment, and emerging consumption trends, alongside comprehensive smart supply chain management services. The company also participates in the trade, wholesale, and processing of raw materials specifically for the electrical appliance industry, and offers a suite of financial services, including customer deposits, interbank lending and borrowing, consumer credit, buyer's credit, and finance leasing. Moreover, the company develops and implements Internet of Things (IoT) solutions to enhance the intelligence of its appliances. Established in 1968, Midea Group Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Foshan, China.

report.description_zh: 美的集團有限公司及其旗下各子公司是全球性的企業巨頭，業務涵蓋家用電器以及中國和國際市場的先進機器人與自動化技術的生產與分銷。其營運策略性地分為四大核心部門：暖通空調、消費電器、機器人與自動化系統，以及多元化的「其他」類別。該公司廣泛的產品組合包括各式各樣的產品，例如家用和商用空調機組、全面的供暖和通風解決方案、廚房必需品、冰箱、洗衣機以及眾多小型家用設備。除了消費品，美的還供應電梯、變頻器、醫療影像設備以及先進的機器人與自動化系統。此外，美的還是重要核心組件的供應商，例如壓縮機、電動機、半導體晶片、閥門、減速器、汽車零件以及複雜的運動控制和自動化技術。他們還生產高低壓變頻器、儲能裝置和冷卻模組，並透過GMCC、Welling、CLOU Electronics、HICONICS、SERVOTRONIX、MR、MOTINOVA、MSCT、TOSHIBA和SUNYE等知名品牌進行分銷。該集團將其專業知識擴展到提供整合建築解決方案，並參與尖端工業機器人、自動化物流系統和專為先進製造環境設計的傳輸技術。美的為醫療保健、娛樂和新興消費趨勢等領域提供專業解決方案，同時提供全面的智慧供應鏈管理服務。該公司還參與電器行業原材料的貿易、批發和加工，並提供一系列金融服務，包括客戶存款、銀行間拆借、消費信貸、買方信貸和融資租賃。此外，該公司開發並實施物聯網（IoT）解決方案，以提升其電器的智慧化程度。美的集團有限公司成立於一九六八年，總部位於中國佛山。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 美的集團憑藉其廣泛的產品組合、全球業務範圍以及在消費電器和工業解決方案領域的多元化佈局，展現出一定的經濟護城河特徵。公司在規模經濟和成本優勢方面表現突出，並在先進技術領域進行戰略性投資。然而，部分業務（如家用電器）面臨激烈競爭，且缺乏關於特定專利強度、管理層誠信或強大網路效應的明確證據。本評估為人工智慧基於可用數據的定性判斷，並非財務測量結果。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Midea Group exhibits certain economic moat characteristics due to its extensive product portfolio, global reach, and diversified presence in both consumer appliances and industrial solutions. The company demonstrates strong economies of scale and cost advantages, alongside strategic investments in advanced technologies. However, some business segments, such as household appliances, face intense competition, and there is a lack of explicit evidence regarding specific patent strength, management integrity, or robust network effects. This assessment represents an AI's qualitative judgment based on available data, not a financial measurement.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 美的集團擁有眾多品牌，包括一些知名品牌，並在全球範圍內運營，這表明其在某些產品類別中具有一定的品牌認知度和潛在的定價能力，尤其是在高端或專業化產品方面。然而，家用電器市場競爭激烈，可能限制了部分產品的定價權。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: Midea Group operates numerous brands, including established names, and has a global presence, suggesting some brand recognition and potential pricing power in certain product categories, particularly for premium or specialized offerings. However, the household appliance market is highly competitive, which may limit pricing power for some products.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 該公司涉足先進機器人與自動化技術、半導體晶片和醫療影像設備等領域。這些行業通常高度依賴知識產權和監管批准。儘管未提供具體專利細節，但這些業務的性質暗示了專利保護的重要性。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company is involved in advanced robotic and automation technologies, semiconductor chips, and medical imaging equipment. These sectors typically rely heavily on intellectual property and regulatory approvals. While specific patent details are not provided, the nature of these businesses implies the importance of patent protection.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 對於使用機器人、自動化系統和整合建築解決方案的工業客戶而言，由於系統整合、客製化和員工培訓，轉換供應商的成本可能相當高。然而，對於消費電器產品，轉換成本通常較低。公司多元化的業務組合導致整體轉換成本影響中等。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: For industrial clients utilizing robotics, automation systems, and integrated building solutions, switching costs can be substantial due to system integration, customization, and employee training. However, for consumer appliance products, switching costs are generally low. The company's diverse business mix results in a moderate overall impact from switching costs.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 公司提及物聯網解決方案，這可能暗示隨著用戶基礎的擴大，平台價值會增加，從而產生網路效應。然而，描述中並未詳細說明這些效應的強度或其是否為主要的護城河驅動因素。對於其大部分產品（如電器），網路效應並非顯著因素。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The company mentions Internet of Things solutions, which could imply network effects where platform value increases with a growing user base. However, the description does not elaborate on the strength of these effects or if they are a primary moat driver. For most of its products, such as appliances, network effects are not a significant factor.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 作為一家「全球性企業巨頭」，擁有「廣泛的產品組合」並是「重要核心組件的供應商」，強烈表明其在製造、採購和分銷方面享有規模經濟。這種龐大的規模很可能使其相對於小型競爭對手具有成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: As a "global powerhouse" with an "extensive product portfolio" and a "significant provider of vital core components," the company strongly indicates economies of scale in manufacturing, procurement, and distribution. This substantial scale likely translates into a cost advantage over smaller competitors.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 沒有任何資訊表明公司擁有獨特的地理資產或自然寡頭壟斷地位。該公司業務遍及全球且多元化，並非依賴於特定的資源地點或區域壟斷。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: There is no information suggesting the company possesses unique geographical assets or operates in natural oligopolies. The business is global and diversified, not tied to specific resource locations or regional monopolies.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司在可用的報告期間內持續產生正向的營業收入和強勁的營運現金流。這表明其營運效率高且成本管理有效，有助於維持穩定的回報。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company consistently generates positive operating income and strong operating cash flow across the available reporting periods. This indicates high operational efficiency and effective cost management, which contributes to sustained returns.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 此維度關乎戰略資產的不可複製性。美的集團投資於先進機器人與自動化技術、半導體晶片和物聯網解決方案，這些領域複雜且需要大量的研發和資本投入。這些投資創造了競爭對手難以迅速複製的戰略資產。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: This dimension pertains to the irreproducibility of strategic assets. Midea Group invests in advanced robotic and automation technologies, semiconductor chips, and IoT solutions, which are complex areas requiring significant research and development and capital expenditure. These investments create strategic assets that are difficult for competitors to replicate quickly.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司在消費品、工業解決方案和組件領域的廣泛多元化，以及對物聯網的關注，表明其有能力適應不斷變化的市場需求和技術進步。雖然消費電器的客戶保留率可能中等，但工業客戶由於整合解決方案通常具有更高的保留率。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: The company's broad diversification across consumer goods, industrial solutions, and components, along with its focus on IoT, suggests an ability to adapt to changing market demands and technological advancements. While consumer appliance customer retention might be moderate, industrial clients often exhibit higher retention due to integrated solutions.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 此維度涵蓋管理層誠信和資本配置。儘管財務數據顯示持續的資本支出和股息支付，表明積極的資本配置，但沒有提供關於管理層誠信的資訊。因此，對此維度的全面評估受到限制。
m10_durability.comment_en: This dimension covers management integrity and capital allocation. While financial data indicates consistent capital expenditures and dividend payments, suggesting active capital allocation, there is no information provided regarding management integrity. Therefore, a comprehensive assessment of this dimension is limited.

profile.description: China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and distributes dairy products under the MENGNIU brand in the People’s Republic of China and internationally. It operates in five segments: Liquid Milk Business, Ice Cream Business, Milk Formula Business, Cheese Business, and Others. The Liquid Milk Business segment offers ultra-high temperature milk, milk beverages, yogurt, and fresh milk. The Ice Cream Business segment manufactures and distributes dairy-based ice cream. The Milk Formula Business segment is involved in the manufacture and distribution of milk powder. The Cheese Business segment engages in the manufacture and distribution of cheese. The Other segment is involved in manufacturing raw materials for daily products; and trading business. It also produces and sells organic food and formula products for babies and toddlers; and provides commercial factoring and financing guarantee services. China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.

transcripts.content:
Unidentified Company Representative: Investors, analysts, reporters, good morning. The 2023 Annual Results Announcement of China Mengniu begins now. On behalf of China Mengniu, I would like to welcome you all to this session and for your long term support and interest and investment into China Mengniu, I would like to express my gratitude. Now let me introduce to you our management. They are Vice Chairman and Executive Director, Mr. Lu Minfang; Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director, Mr. Gao Fei; Vice President and Executive Director, Ms. Wang Yan; Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Zhang Ping; Vice President, Mr. Luo Yan; Vice President, Strategy management person in charge, Chen Yiyi; Vice President, Group Affairs Head, Mr. Li Pengchen; Company Secretary, Mr. Chris Kwok. Now let's begin the first part of today's session. Mr. Lu will go through the company's 2023 results. Mr. Lu, please?
Lu Minfang: Investors, analysts, media friends, good morning. Yesterday, I believe you read the company's announcement. You may be surprised. However, based on some strategic considerations that is an important decision of the Board and the Board and the company's management hope to continue to make our company stronger and bigger. That's a signal and confidence on our part. So I believe friends will have confidence in our company. Mengniu will continue the growth of existing business and also we will expedite innovative business and globalization strategies. We will develop young and next-generation management leaders. We'll continue to create value for our investors and working partners. Yesterday was 26th March. Today I'm in the capacity of Vice Chairman and Executive Director. So I would like to express this on behalf of the Chairman. This adjustment to the Board will be beneficial to the overall development of China Mengniu, and it can maintain long-term stability and achieve high quality development for the company. So with these remarks, then I hope that we will focus more on today's presentation and discussion about our results. Sof if there are discussion about personal perhaps those can happen in the future in private. Now as usual, I will first do an overview of our business and in the following Q&A session, Mr. Gao Fei will continue the discussion with you. 2023 financial overview. I think you have read the information on our annual report. In 2023 for Mainland dairy product industry, there were both challenges and opportunities. You can see that our overall revenue was up 6.5% in the industry. This growth rate is very fast. And number one is that for liquid milk and the high end has done very well, for deluxe and you have achieved about RMB30 billion two or three years ago. And for the UHT, it has also always been your strong department. And for this year, how do you look at UHT's continuous optimization and for this year for some of the functional product for instance of base milk et cetera. What are your targets and of course, we said that UHT is Mr. Coffey's department and going forward, you know you will be looking after across the board, and we also heard Mr. Lu saying that for ice cream and chilled and there will be more focus and strategic considerations. Can you please share with us? My second question is that just now Mr. Lu talked about this in terms of the channels changes, and optimization in the past five years. Sometimes we feel it's slow, sometimes very suddenly there will be a change, and for instance the online business and live streaming as well as O2O and their impact on the offline business. And we can also see that, for instance, in terms of the channel changes and channel transformation optimization, and I'm just curious how do you look at the development of both online and offline business? So would you consider about the margin, because with the traditional business for supermarkets, et cetera, you don't really make much money. So now with a very intense competition how do you look at different planning for different channels and their impact they're off on your margins? Thank you.
Lu Minfang: Thank you. Let me take this question. Yes, indeed from 2023, for UHT optimization and high end product. It has grown very well and going forward the continuous optimization trend will stay for instance. We look at by quarterly performance, the overall trend is there and for our whole company the continued optimization will be further strengthened in our current product structure, whether it is room temperature for milk deluxe, or shiny metal or our fresh cheese, and fresh milk product et cetera. So, we all have some excellent products. So, we don't really worry about this. And secondly functional milk, is a trend as you say in your second question. We have also made some deployment. In addition, what are the further details and divisions of these functional drinks, and including in the UHT product and for the functions of the product and we have made a certain deployment, and certain arrangement. And thirdly, talking about the changes of the channels, yes indeed, in China the change in the channel, is actually very fast and even faster than the overall faster moving consumer goods, and in offline there are also many channels. So not only just online and for the retail business, there's a lot of challenge and pressure. So regardless of what sort of a channel it is, it is all business for us. And for us, it's really about how to do well in the detailed segment, detailed channels, and create a better synergy between online and offline business. Thank you.
Unidentified Analyst: Okay. Great. Thank you.
Operator: We now go into the media QA question. So we first of all welcome the journalist from a Junxing News Agency. Thank you. This is [Dai Xiaotong]. I have a question for Mr. Li. We can see that in Mengniu development strategy and that you focus on green development, you have also participated in the first climate change forum. And what is the progress in ESG development and what are the new deployment, and plans for this year? Thank you.
Li Pengchen: Thank you for your question. So two days ago, I participated in Hong Kong's first Climate Change Forum, and this was co-organized with Hong Kong University and the Ministry of Environment in China. So our target is 2030 and 2060. And for Mengniu, and we want to achieve carbon neutral by 2050. So for the 14th five-year plan, and we have our green strategy. And for the milk business, we can see that it's a very long supply chain. So for Mengniu as a leader in our industry. And we are working hard on reducing the carbon emission in the whole industry. And for instance last year we have five major measures, and we have also expressed to our investors and journalists, and for instance the usage of energy as well as photovoltaic and the treatment of manure, the feed that we give to the cattle, et cetera. We're trying our hardest to reduce the carbon emission from the upstream. All our farms including modern dairy and [shungmui], et cetera. And in terms of the waste recycling usage, and has all increased and we have been able to reduce 85.2 tons of carbon emission. At the moment we have about 30 factories and in Yunnan we have carbon zero factory. And the last May in India, we have also been able to establish the first digitized factory. And we have 100 people and with a production of RMB10 billion. And in terms of the energy, consumption has also reduced by 42%. And then downstream, we have the packaging business and we started with the green packaging and Mengniu is the first Chinese dairy company has said that by 2030 - we'll achieve zero forest destruction. And so, this is a meaning about for instance soybeans and palm oil. And last year our company has also established a green packaging team, and for June this year we will launch the first green packaging white paper for Mengniu. And all these policies, and we are pushing forward, for sustainable development of a Mengniu. Mr. Lu has also said that yesterday, a lot of the directors also pay a lot of attention to the sustainability development for Mengniu. And I can tell you that we are ahead of our peers, and therefore our MSCI is AA. And we are the first comprehensive dairy company, to achieve this in addition with the Milk Deluxe and we are number one. And for instance, we are also included in Standard & Poor's, first batch of sustainable development company. And last year, we were also invited by the Ministry of Environment, to participate in the Climate Change COP Conference held in Dubai, and to represent Chinese companies and share our experiences. So for Mengniu as a leading company in terms of sustainability and in ESG, we continue to lead the whole industry, for the achievement of dual carbon and we are making contributions. Thank you.
Operator: We welcome the last question from the media. And we welcome this journalist from Xinhua News Agency.
Unidentified Analyst: Thank you. So at the moment in terms of the market, we pay attention to the new productivity. And in terms of building smarter productivity and what are the areas that Mengniu is considering?
Li Pengchen: So perhaps I'll take this question again, and I have worked in Xinhua News Agency before, so it's better that I can answer this question. And this question is a very important question actually. So this word smart, or new novel productivity is a new concept and this has provided Mengniu, with a strategic opportunity. And at the moment, there are many studies on this, so what is new and smart high quality productivity. New as the name suggests is innovation and we have heard about HMO and my action et cetera. And HMO has resolved all the strangling issues. Another one is digitalized innovation, and digital innovation in Mengniu. We have already entered into era 3.0 from the demand and supply. So number three, and it's about the innovation of the models, in terms of quality this word is about high quality development. In Chinese dairy industry last year during the world dairy conference it's about more nutritious, smarter and higher quality. This was put forward by Mr. Lu last year. And Mengniu, we are also grasping this opportunity of new high-quality productivity. And to continue to push forward the high-quality growth of Mengniu as a whole. In the interest of time, 2023 annual results of Mengniu has come to an end. If you would like to know more about our detailed financial performance and the data, please go to our website, and to refer to the announcement made on the 26th of March. If you have further questions, please feel free to contact the IR team of Mengniu. In the meantime, we have also placed a lot of our products outside in the foyer. And we welcome you take our products and taste our products yourself.
Lu Minfang: Thank you very much for participating in our annual results today. And we will try our hardest, and to work in all the areas possible. Thank you and goodbye.

report.description_zh: 中國蒙牛乳業有限公司是一家投資控股公司，在中華人民共和國及國際市場以蒙牛品牌生產及分銷乳製品。公司業務分為五個分部：液態奶業務、冰淇淋業務、奶粉業務、芝士業務及其他。液態奶業務分部提供超高溫奶、乳飲料、優格及鮮奶。冰淇淋業務分部製造及分銷乳製品冰淇淋。奶粉業務分部從事奶粉的製造及分銷。芝士業務分部從事芝士的製造及分銷。其他分部涉及日常產品原材料的製造及貿易業務。公司亦生產及銷售嬰幼兒有機食品及配方產品；並提供商業保理及融資擔保服務。中國蒙牛乳業有限公司於一九九九年成立，總部設於香港銅鑼灣。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 中國蒙牛乳業在品牌實力、規模成本優勢、專有技術及監管批准方面展現出顯著的經濟護城河特徵。公司透過長期品牌建設和高端產品策略，維持一定的定價能力。其龐大的運營規模在採購、生產和分銷上帶來成本優勢，並在原奶供應過剩的市場中對小型競爭者構成挑戰。在HMO技術和特定合規認證方面，公司也享有獨特的監管和技術優勢。管理層對營運效率、ESG治理和資本配置的重視，以及對市場變化的積極應對，進一步增強了公司的持久性。然而，在轉換成本和網絡效應方面缺乏明確證據。本評估基於有限的公開資料，分數為人工智慧的定性判斷，並非財務測量結果。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited exhibits significant economic moat characteristics in brand strength, scale-based cost advantage, proprietary technology, and regulatory approvals. The company maintains pricing power through long-term brand building and premium product strategies. Its vast operational scale provides cost advantages in procurement, production, and distribution, posing a challenge to smaller competitors in a market with raw milk oversupply. The company also enjoys unique regulatory and technological advantages in HMO technology and specific compliance certifications. Management's emphasis on operational efficiency, ESG governance, capital allocation, and proactive adaptation to market changes further enhances the company's durability. However, there is a lack of clear evidence regarding switching costs and network effects. This assessment is based on limited public data, and the scores represent AI qualitative judgments, not financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 公司透過長期贊助大型國際賽事及合作夥伴，積極投入品牌建設，並強調其高端產品線如特侖蘇、每日鮮語及優益C的市場表現。管理層明確表示透過品牌建設提升產品溢價，並避免低價競爭，顯示其品牌資產有助於維持一定的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The company actively invests in brand building through long-term sponsorships of major international events and partnerships, emphasizing the market performance of its premium product lines such as Milk Deluxe, Shiny Meadow, and YO!FINE DIARY. Management explicitly states its strategy to enhance product premium through brand building and avoid low-price competition, indicating that its brand equity helps maintain a degree of pricing power.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司在中國獲得HMO技術的獨家批准，是三家獲批企業中唯一的中國公司。其嬰幼兒及老年人營養產品業務屬於高度監管領域，進入門檻高。此外，公司聲稱是中國乳製品行業中唯一獲得特定合規管理體系認證的企業。這些因素表明公司在監管和專有技術方面具有競爭優勢。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company has obtained exclusive approval for HMO technology in China, being the only Chinese company among three approved. Its infant and elderly nutrition product businesses operate in highly regulated areas with high entry barriers. Furthermore, the company claims to be the only dairy enterprise in China to receive a specific compliance management system certificate. These factors indicate a competitive advantage in regulatory compliance and proprietary technology.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 提供的資料中沒有明確證據表明客戶轉換成本高昂。乳製品通常是消費必需品，消費者轉換到競爭對手產品的實際成本或努力程度很低。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: There is no explicit evidence in the provided data to suggest high customer switching costs. Dairy products are typically consumer staples where the actual cost or effort for consumers to switch to a competitor's product is low.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 蒙牛在包裝食品行業（特別是乳製品）運營。這類業務通常不具備網絡效應，即產品或服務的價值不會隨著用戶數量的增加而增加。提供的資料中沒有證據表明存在網絡效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: Mengniu operates in the packaged foods industry, specifically dairy. This type of business typically does not exhibit network effects, where the value of a product or service increases as more users join. There is no evidence in the provided materials to suggest the presence of network effects.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 蒙牛是一家規模龐大的乳製品公司，業務遍及國內外，營收可觀。管理層明確指出其增長在乳製品公司中處於領先地位，且其規模在原奶供應過剩的環境中具有優勢，小型競爭對手面臨挑戰。公司亦提及資本支出高峰已過，暗示現有產能充足。這表明其龐大規模可能在採購、生產和分銷方面帶來成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: Mengniu is a very large dairy company with substantial revenue, operating both domestically and internationally. Management explicitly states that its growth is leading among dairy companies and that its scale provides an advantage, especially in an environment of raw milk oversupply where smaller competitors are challenged. The company also notes that its capital expenditure peak is over, implying significant existing capacity. This suggests that its large scale likely provides cost advantages in procurement, production, and distribution.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 提供的資料中沒有證據表明蒙牛受益於獨特的地理資產、導致自然寡頭壟斷的有效規模，或因地理位置而獲得關鍵資源的獨家使用權。儘管其業務遍及中國及國際，這本身並未賦予其經濟護城河意義上的獨特地理優勢。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: There is no evidence in the provided materials to suggest that Mengniu benefits from unique geographical assets, efficient scale leading to a natural oligopoly, or exclusive access to critical resources due to location. While it operates across China and internationally, this does not inherently confer a unique geographical advantage in the sense of an economic moat.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司報告毛利率擴大及經營利潤率提升，並設定了持續提高經營利潤率的目標。管理層亦聲稱存貨和應收賬款等營運效率指標有所改善。儘管淨利潤在不同年度間存在波動，但對提高經營利潤率和營運效率的重視表明公司致力於維持資本回報。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company reports expanding gross profit and an increase in operating profit margin, with a stated goal to continue raising operating profit margin. Management also claims improvements in operational efficiency indicators such as inventory and receivables. While net income shows volatility across different annual periods, the focus on improving operating profit margin and operational efficiency suggests a commitment to sustained capital returns.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 管理層承認過去在資本配置方面存在問題，包括收購業務的整合以及對高增長品牌的資源分配過於保守。然而，他們也指出資本支出高峰已過，自由現金流改善，並提高了股息派發。目前的重點是盈利能力、現金流和股東回報，對新的併購持謹慎態度。公司已建立大規模的生產和分銷網絡，並投資於品牌和研發，這些都是難以複製的戰略資產。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: Management acknowledges past issues with capital allocation, including the integration of acquired businesses and being too conservative in allocating resources to high-growth brands. However, they also indicate that the peak of capital expenditure is over, leading to improved free cash flow and increased dividend payouts. The current focus is on profitability, cash flow, and shareholder returns, with a cautious approach to new M&A. The company has built a large-scale production and distribution network and invested in brands and R&D, which are strategic assets difficult to reproduce.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 蒙牛意識到消費者需求不斷變化，並積極投資於研發和數位轉型以應對這些趨勢。管理層相信高品質營養健康產品的需求將持續存在，且不同市場區隔仍有增長潛力。這種積極主動的策略表明公司對需求變化的韌性以及利用科技保持相關性的能力。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Mengniu demonstrates awareness of evolving consumer demands and actively invests in R&D and digital transformation to address these trends. Management believes that high-quality nutrition and health products will maintain demand and that different market segments still offer growth potential. This proactive approach suggests a degree of resilience to demand disruption and an ability to leverage technology to stay relevant.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 管理層明確強調長期穩定、高品質發展以及為投資者創造價值。公司在ESG方面取得顯著成就，包括高MSCI評級和在乳製品行業合規治理方面的領先地位。對盈利能力、現金流改善和股東回報的明確關注，加上對過去資本配置挑戰的反思，表明管理團隊對其職責有清晰認識，並致力於健全的治理和資本管理。
m10_durability.comment_en: Management explicitly emphasizes long-term stability, high-quality development, and creating value for investors. The company highlights significant achievements in ESG, including a high MSCI rating and leadership in compliance governance within the dairy industry. The clear focus on profitability, cash flow improvement, and shareholder returns, coupled with self-reflection on past capital allocation challenges, suggests a management team aware of its responsibilities and committed to sound governance and capital stewardship.

profile.description: Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd. is a leading global enterprise specializing in the design, production, and sale of intelligent home appliances, with operations spanning Asia, Europe, North America, Australia, Africa, and other international regions. The company structures its extensive business through three key divisions: its China Smart Home Business, the Overseas Home Appliance and Smart Home Business, and a broader 'Other Business' segment. Its comprehensive product offerings include a wide array of smart home solutions, featuring major appliances such as refrigerators, freezers, washing machines, air conditioners, water heaters, and dishwashers. The portfolio also extends to gas stoves, various kitchen and small home appliances, and advanced water purification products, alongside integrated smart home ecosystem solutions. Beyond its primary manufacturing focus, Haier Smart Home engages in diverse activities. These encompass environmental protection and artificial intelligence technology consulting, software development, technical services, and advertising design. The company is also active in IoT technology research and development, computer hardware and software technical support, asset management, and equity investments. Furthermore, its operations include hazardous waste management, the development, assembly, and sales of plastic and electronic components, and cutting-edge research in home appliances, communications, electronic products, and network engineering technologies. It also manufactures precision plastics, sheet metal, molds, and electronic parts specifically for home appliances. Founded in 1984 and based in Qingdao, China, the company adopted its current name, Haier Smart Home Co., Ltd., in June 2019, having previously been known as Qingdao Haier Co., Ltd.

report.description_zh: 海爾智家股份有限公司是一家全球領先的企業，專注於智慧家電的設計、生產和銷售，業務遍及亞洲、歐洲、北美、澳洲、非洲及其他國際地區。公司透過三大主要事業部來構建其廣泛的業務：中國智慧家庭事業、海外家電及智慧家庭事業，以及更廣泛的「其他業務」部門。其全面的產品組合包括各種智慧家庭解決方案，涵蓋冰箱、冰櫃、洗衣機、空調、熱水器和洗碗機等主要家電。產品範圍還擴展到燃氣灶、各種廚房和小型家電，以及先進的淨水產品，同時提供整合的智慧家庭生態系統解決方案。除了其主要的製造業務外，海爾智家還從事多樣化的活動。這些活動包括環保和人工智慧技術諮詢、軟體開發、技術服務和廣告設計。公司也積極參與物聯網技術研發、電腦硬體和軟體技術支援、資產管理和股權投資。此外，其業務還包括危險廢物管理、塑膠和電子元件的開發、組裝和銷售，以及家電、通訊、電子產品和網路工程技術的尖端研究。它還專門為家電製造精密塑膠、鈑金、模具和電子零件。公司於一九八四年成立，總部位於中國青島，於二零一九年六月採用現名海爾智家股份有限公司，此前曾名為青島海爾股份有限公司。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 海爾智家展現出在智慧家電市場中具有顯著全球規模和品牌影響力的業務。其廣泛的國際營運和多元的產品組合表明其擁有強大的成本優勢。公司對整合智慧家庭解決方案和先進技術研究的專注，預示著潛在的客戶鎖定效應和智慧財產權保護。財務表現顯示營收持續增長、獲利能力良好，以及穩健的現金流產生，這支持了對其營運效率和透過股東回報進行良好資本配置的評估。然而，關於強大網路效應、獨特地理資產或詳細客戶保留指標的具體證據並未明確提供。本次評估基於所提供的公司描述和財務報表進行定性判斷，並未納入未提供的財報電話會議記錄中的見解。所給予的分數為定性判斷，而非來自報告的財務衡量指標。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Haier Smart Home demonstrates a business with significant global scale and brand presence in the intelligent home appliance market. Its extensive international operations and broad product portfolio suggest a strong cost advantage. The company's focus on integrated smart home solutions and advanced technology research indicates potential for customer lock-in and intellectual property protection. Financial performance shows consistent revenue growth, healthy profitability, and robust cash flow generation, supporting an assessment of operational efficiency and sound capital allocation through shareholder returns. However, specific evidence for strong network effects, unique geographical assets, or detailed customer retention metrics is not explicitly available. This assessment relies on qualitative judgment based on the provided company description and financial statements, and does not incorporate insights from earnings call transcripts, which were not provided. The assigned scores are qualitative judgments and not derived from reported financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 作為一家全球領先的企業，海爾智家在智慧家電領域擁有廣泛的產品線和國際業務，這通常意味著其品牌具有一定的市場認可度和影響力，可能在某些產品類別中具備一定的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: As a leading global enterprise in intelligent home appliances with an extensive product line and international operations, Haier Smart Home's brand likely holds market recognition and influence, potentially affording some pricing power in certain product categories.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司積極參與人工智慧、物聯網技術研發以及家電、通訊、電子產品和網路工程技術的尖端研究，這強烈暗示其可能擁有或正在尋求專利保護。此外，危險廢物管理等業務可能涉及特定的監管許可。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company's active involvement in AI, IoT technology R&D, and cutting-edge research in home appliances, communications, electronic products, and network engineering technologies strongly suggests it likely holds or pursues patent protection. Additionally, operations like hazardous waste management may involve specific regulatory licenses.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 海爾智家提供整合的智慧家庭生態系統解決方案，這可能為客戶帶來一定的轉換成本。一旦客戶投資於其生態系統中的多個智慧設備，轉換到其他品牌可能會涉及不便和額外支出。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: Haier Smart Home offers integrated smart home ecosystem solutions, which could create some switching costs for customers. Once customers invest in multiple smart devices within its ecosystem, transitioning to another brand might involve inconvenience and additional expenses.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 儘管公司專注於物聯網技術研發和智慧家庭生態系統，但所提供的資訊並未明確說明其產品或服務如何透過用戶數量的增加而顯著提升價值，從而形成強大的網路效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: Although the company focuses on IoT technology R&D and smart home ecosystems, the provided information does not explicitly detail how its products or services significantly increase in value with a growing user base, thus creating strong network effects.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 作為一家全球領先的企業，業務遍及多個國際地區，並擁有廣泛的生產和產品線，海爾智家顯然具備巨大的規模。這種規模很可能使其在採購、製造和分銷方面享有顯著的成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: As a leading global enterprise with operations across multiple international regions and an extensive production and product line, Haier Smart Home clearly possesses significant scale. This scale likely affords it substantial cost advantages in procurement, manufacturing, and distribution.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 公司描述了其製造精密塑膠和電子零件的能力，以及危險廢物管理業務，這些顯示了營運能力，但沒有證據表明其擁有獨特的地理位置優勢或自然形成的寡頭壟斷條件。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The company describes its capabilities in manufacturing precision plastics and electronic parts, as well as hazardous waste management operations, which indicate operational strengths. However, there is no evidence suggesting unique geographical advantages or conditions that create a natural oligopoly.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司在可觀察的年度期間內展現出持續的營收增長、健康的淨利潤和強勁的營運現金流。儘管毛利率略有波動，但營運利潤率保持相對穩定，表明其營運效率良好。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company demonstrates consistent revenue growth, healthy net income, and robust operating cash flow over the observable annual periods. Despite some fluctuation in gross margins, operating margins remain relatively stable, indicating good operational efficiency.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司從事資產管理和股權投資，並進行尖端技術研究，這些都是資本配置的活動。然而，缺乏關於這些投資成果或其如何創造難以複製的戰略資產的具體證據，因此無法評估其有效性。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company engages in asset management and equity investments, and conducts cutting-edge technology research, all of which are capital allocation activities. However, specific evidence regarding the outcomes of these investments or how they create irreproducible strategic assets is lacking, preventing an assessment of their effectiveness.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司專注於智慧家電和整合智慧家庭生態系統，這表明其致力於透過技術創新來吸引和留住客戶。然而，沒有明確的證據表明其客戶保留率高於行業平均水平，或其產品具有顯著的抗技術或需求顛覆能力。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: The company's focus on intelligent home appliances and integrated smart home ecosystems suggests an effort to attract and retain customers through technological innovation. However, there is no explicit evidence of above-average customer retention rates or significant resistance to technological or demand disruption for its products.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司持續產生正向且不斷增長的自由現金流，並透過股息支付和股票回購向股東返還價值。這種穩健的財務管理和對股東回報的承諾，表明了良好的資本配置實踐，有助於業務的長期穩健性。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company consistently generates positive and growing free cash flow, and returns value to shareholders through dividend payments and share repurchases. This sound financial management and commitment to shareholder returns indicate good capital allocation practices, contributing to the long-term robustness of the business.

profile.companyName: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc.
profile.description: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. is a prominent provider of private educational services operating under the "New Oriental" brand across the People's Republic of China. Its operations are broadly organized into segments focusing on K-12 after-school tutoring, test preparation, online learning platforms, and other educational offerings. The company assists students in preparing for crucial language and admission examinations required by academic institutions in the United States, mainland China, and Commonwealth nations. It also delivers after-school academic support for primary and secondary students aiming to boost their scores, alongside English language instruction for younger learners. Furthermore, New Oriental offers a diverse array of language courses, including English and several other foreign languages like German, Japanese, French, Korean, Italian, and Spanish. The group manages a full-time private primary and secondary school in Yangzhou, featuring a comprehensive curriculum with a strong emphasis on English. Additionally, it develops and publishes proprietary educational materials for language training and test preparation, while also providing online education programs catering to pre-school, K-12, and college-level students. Supplementary services include overseas studies consulting and international educational tours. As of May 31, 2021, its extensive network encompassed 122 schools, 1,547 learning centers, 11 bookstores, and its various online learning platforms. Founded in 1993, New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. is headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
