Operator: Good day, and welcome to the NetEase Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call. Today's conference is being recorded. At this time, I would like to turn the conference over to Brandi Piacente. Please go ahead.
Brandi Piacente: Thank you, operator. Please note that today's discussion will contain forward-looking statements relating to the future performance of the company and are intended to qualify for the safe harbor from liability as established by the U.S. Private Securities Litigation Reform Act. Such statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, assumptions and other factors. Some of these risks are beyond the company's control and could cause actual results to differ materially from those mentioned in today's press release and this discussion. A general discussion of the risk factors that could affect NetEase's business and financial results is included in certain filings of the company with the Securities and Exchange Commission, including its annual report on Form 20-F and in announcements and filings on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's website. The company does not undertake any obligation to update this forward-looking information, except as required by law. During today's call, management will also discuss certain non-GAAP financial measures, which should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. For a definition of non-GAAP financial measures and a reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial results, please see the second quarter 2026 earnings news release issued earlier today. As a reminder, this conference is being recorded. In addition, an investor presentation and a webcast replay of this conference call will be available on the NetEase corporate website at ir.netease.com. Joining us today on the call from NetEase's senior management are Mr. William Ding, Chief Executive Officer; Mr. Hu Zhipeng, Executive Vice President; Ms. Aileen Mo, Vice President of Finance; and Mr. Bill Pang, Vice President of Corporate Development. I will now turn the call over to Bill, who will read the prepared remarks on William's behalf. Bill?
Bill Pang: Thank you, Brandi, and welcome, everyone, to today's call. Before we begin, I would like to remind everyone that all percentages are based on RMB. In the first half of 2026, we delivered healthy growth across business segments. Total revenue reached RMB 30.1 billion in the second quarter, driven by the solid performance of our games business. Our games and related value-add services generated net revenues of RMB 25 billion, reflecting the broader appeal of our portfolio in both domestic and overseas markets. The strength of our portfolio stems from our sustained focus on innovation across the full life cycle of our games from original concept and development through long-term live operations. By combining our engineering capabilities, creative design expertise and disciplined execution, we bring new ideas to life and deliver fresh experiences across genres, platforms and markets. One recent example is Sea of Remnants, released in China in July. It showcases our ongoing emphasis on original IP and genre innovation. Built on our in-house game engine, Sea of Remnants combines a distinctive visual style with an open world ocean fantasy setting. Players -- by combining naval combat, extraction gameplay and roguelike progression, the game creates varied adventures that unfold differently each time. Across themed Island, players encounter a wide cast of characters that bring each island to life through meaningful interactions and evolve storylines. A variety of brand and content collaborations have also expanded the game's reach, extending its content ecosystem beyond the core gameplay experience. We are also preparing for the game's global rollout and look forward to introducing Sea of Remnants to players worldwide. Our innovation efforts are not only limited to new launches. They extend across our established titles where we keep evolving gameplay systems, introducing new content and strengthening live operations to sustain player enthusiasm over time. Sword of Justice launched its major anniversary update, New World in June. The comprehensive upgrade to the open world experience improved visual quality, streamlined cultivation system and refined the in-game economy, creating a more enjoyable experience for both returning and new players. It also introduced the Dali, highly immersive new region to expand exploration and add greater storytelling depth. The community response was strong with active players exceeding 10 million on launch day and concurrent users reaching a 2-year high, demonstrating the title's ongoing appeal. Players continue to gravitate to Identity V with a steady cadence of live service updates, including anniversary content, crossover events and new gameplay experiences. In June, the game introduced Cryptic Notes, a new PVE mode that offers a lighter experience beyond its core PVP gameplay, opening up new ways for the community to play. This excitement carried into July with the launch of Season 44, introducing new themed costumes and events alongside the latest Paperbride crossover. This update sparked active discussions across live streaming and social media platforms, helping keep the community engaged and reinforcing the game's long-term appeal. During the second quarter, the NARAKA: BLADEPOINT franchise unified its PC and mobile ecosystems. Players can now enjoy the game's signature melee combat seamlessly across devices while strengthening connections across its broader player community. Building on the increased connectivity, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT kicked off its fifth anniversary celebration in July with a major content update that introduced all new land and underwater battlefields as well as a new underwater combat system. These additions refreshed the game's core experience and drove strong player engagement across platforms. Eggy Party further solidified its position as China's leading party game destination. It reached a new milestone with 700 million registered users and monthly active users remained steadily above 100 million. In June, the game celebrated its fourth anniversary, bringing another wave of player activity, supported by diverse gameplay, a vibrant UGC ecosystem and a rich slate of live operations. This strong momentum continued into the summer with Eggy Party remaining among the top ranked titles on both China's iOS top download and grossing chart and peaking at #3 on the top grossing chart. Peak daily active users also reached a multiyear high for the summer period. UGC remains one of Eggy Party's defining strengths -- over the past year, the ecosystem has continued to thrive, supported by more powerful creation tools and a growing base of engaged creators. Total creator rewards reached a new milestone of RMB 200 million to date, reflecting both the vitality of this creator community and strong player demand for diverse user-generated content. Recent upgrades to the editor, including integration with multiple AI models have also made it easier for creators to learn, create and program. Together, these efforts expand what players can create and support Eggy Party's evolution from a stand-alone party game into a broader content platform. Our flagship MMORPG, Fantasy Westward Journey Online continues to evolve across both its classic and unlimited servers. During the summer, its new expansion pack and Dunhuang in the content further engaged players, underscoring its timely popularity and its healthy community. Meanwhile, Fantasy Westward Journey Mobile carried its record-setting momentum into the second quarter, supported by refinements to the in-game economy and ongoing gameplay iterations. During the quarter, the game introduced a new equipment progression system and an extraction gameplay mode. These additions created fresh progression paths and greater strategic depth, gaining real traction with players. In July, the summer Treasure Pavilion offered a wider selection of costumes and items tailored to players' preferences, driving robust commercial performance. The launch of the Origin server helped the Westward Journey Return build strong momentum in the second quarter. By preserving the iconic appeal of the Westward Journey franchise while introducing a portrait mode interface and more relaxed gameplay, the Origin server delivers a more accessible experience that players can enjoy anytime and anywhere, contributing to the title's strong performance in Q2. Infinite Borders further reinforced its leading position in the SLG genre through new innovative gameplay and initiatives designed to address community needs. New features such as EC Border Q, a social deduction game mode, were well received by players, while its collaboration with Minecraft China helped the game reach a broader and younger audience. The launch of the highly anticipated special servers together with a series of pre-anniversary events ahead of its 11th anniversary, generated renewed excitement across the community, demonstrating the title's enduring appeal and continued relevance in the strategy game market. Alongside our success in the domestic market, we made additional steady progress in broadening our global reach. Where Winds Meet has demonstrated a healthy growth trajectory since its successful launch -- global launch last year. The player base continued to grow in the second quarter with positive reviews on Steam staying above 87%. In June, we brought this immersive open world action RPG to even more players worldwide with the successful launch on Xbox. The game also repeatedly ranked among the top 3 titles on Steam's global top-seller chart following major content updates. This underscores the long-term potential of content-driven games and highlights our proven capabilities in delivering high-quality content and live operations. In the domestic market, Where Winds Meet also expanded its player community in the quarter with major new region additions, including Qingchuan and Hangzhou. The Hangzhou expansion proved particularly popular and pushed the game to #3 spot on China's iOS top grossing chart. This update brought distinctive local culture, fresh narrative and immersive exploration, driving year-over-year growth in quarterly revenue and achieving record high monthly active users. Marvel Rivals continued to build on its global success through a steady stream of seasonal content, live service updates and community initiatives. In June, the game introduced a refreshed 18 versus 18 mode setting K'un-Lun Arena, alongside new heroes, maps and events that broaden gameplay variety. The Rivals summer festival added further momentum with a wide selection of themed costumes for fan favorite characters, help pushing the game to #2 on global top seller chart and #1 in multiple regions, including the United States. Most recently, the franchise extended its reach beyond the screen through real-world touch points across major fan events. At San Diego Comic-Con in late July, Marvel Rivals generated even more excitement among players with new announcements and interactive fan activities. The new season finals was later held in Los Angeles, attracting top players and fans while reinforcing the title's competitive ecosystem and long-term live service foundation. As we continue to grow our existing portfolio, we're also advancing the development of new titles and exploring fresh ideas across diverse genres, gameplay experiences and markets. Ananta is progressing steadily towards launch as a free-to-play urban open world RPG -- the game invites players to experience a vibrant modern city through a variety of characters, lifestyles and activities, providing a high degree of freedom in exploration and interaction. With strong anticipation from player community, we will continue to share more updates as development progresses. Blood Message made a strong impression at the Summer Game Fest, where overseas audience responded positively to the latest gameplay footage. The trailer has since generated around 40 million views globally with players praising its visual fidelity, distinctive storytelling and thematic combat. Our commitment to innovation and long-term operating capabilities also created value for our partner titles. Blizzard titles performed well in China during the quarter, supported by localized operations and a steady stream of updates. World of Warcraft and Hearthstone continue to engage their long-standing communities in China, backed by consistent updates and initiatives tailored to the local market. Overwatch celebrated its 10th anniversary during the quarter with special content, rewards and activities that revitalize players and drove a significant increase in active users. Diablo IV further expanded its presence in China through exclusive localized content, localized events and newly introduced Chinese mythology skins, driving solid growth in both active users and player retention during the second quarter. Together, these achievements reflect the breadth and strength of our portfolio from new releases to essential titles across China and global markets through both our own IP and partner collaborations. We aim to keep our games relevant and engaging through new ideas, ongoing content updates and disciplined live operations while responding to evolving player expectations. This innovative mindset will continue to guide us as we build stronger communities and create even more compelling experiences for players worldwide. Turning to our other businesses. Youdao further advanced its AI native strategy and deepen AI-driven innovation across its ecosystem. In the second quarter, Youdao launched its latest large language model Confucius 4 with substantially enhanced capabilities. The new model delivered stronger performance in visual math and physics reasoning, particularly on complex diagrams at lower inference cost. Youdao also upgraded its translation model with an efficient acceleration mechanism, increasing inference speed by approximately 80%. Beyond large language models, it further advanced its AI agent capabilities towards autonomous execution of complex real-world tasks, demonstrating stronger capabilities beyond simple Q&A interactions. The Learning Services segment continued its healthy development, driven by the strong performance of Youdao. Popular features, including AI-powered English essay grading, AI recommendations and AI-based college admission advisers continue to enhance user satisfaction and drive higher user retention. Within the segment, AI-driven subscriptions also maintained strong momentum. The advertising efficiency in Youdao's online marketing services also continued to improve. We recently launched a second-generation AI ad placement optimizer, further enhancing the user experience and advertising efficiency with more streamlined and automated features. While capturing emerging opportunities in areas such as AI application and short-form dramas, Youdao also made steady progress in client acquisition and retention. The smart devices segment sustained its focus on product innovation with the Youdao Victory Pen maintaining a strong market position. In June, we launched the Youdao Dictionary Pen X8, featuring an expanded library of 80 million words and photo-based tutoring across a broad range of subjects. During the 618 Shopping Festival, Youdao Dictionary Pen ranked #1 in sales on JD.com and Tmall within this category for the seventh consecutive year. Looking ahead, Youdao will continue to execute its AI native strategy across learning and advertising scenarios. For NetEase Cloud Music, we further developed its music-centric ecosystem in the first half of 2026, prioritizing exceptional user experiences, distinctive content and a vibrant music community to support healthy and steady growth. Enhancements to user experience and strong brand perception continue to drive higher user engagement and expanding the daily active user base. Our DAU versus MAU ratio remained above 30% in the first half of 2026, increasing both year-over-year and sequentially. The average daily mobile music listing time also rose steadily with penetration rates of community content consumption and interactions improving notably. In particular, retention and renewal rates across our expanded membership base increased both year-over-year and sequentially, reflecting stronger user loyalty and deeper connection to the platform. We also enriched our comprehensive and distinctive content library by expanding copyrighted music and promoting original music. Earlier this year, we renewed partnerships with major labels such as Universal Music Group as well as added new content and Chinese labels, OSPs and variety show music, while enhancing our signature genres. At the same time, we continue to promote original Chinese music with our recent in-house releases such as December 31, gaining widespread acclaim. From a product perspective, we remain focused on user needs, advancing innovation across music discovery and consumption experiences while galvanizing our community by making music exploration more intuitive and engaging on the platform. We also launched innovative functions such as AI-inspired playlist to address users' diverse music discovery preferences. Subscription-based membership grew as well, improving our music-oriented monetization. We further refined membership benefits built around content, features, personalization privileges and office-related offerings, all of which enhance the platform's overall value proposition and support ongoing membership growth. Turning to Yanxuan. Yanxuan once again secured leading positions on e-commerce platforms across its key categories in the second quarter. New products in pet food, home scent and home goods categories performed well, generating healthy growth. Notably, the freshly steamed pet food series, which we launched last year with our differentiated steaming technology and fresh meat recipes continue to deliver solid sales while earning recognition from leading industry organizations. In closing, across the NetEase family of businesses, we remain committed to innovation and staying at the forefront of technology. By integrating leading technologies into every stage of product development and operation, we create compelling user experiences that help shape industry trends. This approach continues to support sustainable growth across our business. In our games portfolio, in particular, it enhances the appeal of both established titles and new releases, extending our success in China to broader global -- throughout the year, we will continue to foster an environment that empowers our developers to push creative boundaries. As we advance our products with cutting-edge technology, we believe we are well positioned to create even more engaging experiences and enduring value for players, communities and shareholders alike. That concludes William's comments, and I will turn the call over to Aileen for more detailed discussion of our financial results. Thank you.
Aileen Bin Mo: Thank you, Bill. I will now provide a brief review of our 2026 interim financial results with a focus on the second quarter. Given the limited time on today's call, I will present some abbreviated financial highlights. We encourage you to read through our press release issued earlier today for further details. As a reminder, all amounts are in RMB unless otherwise stated. Our total net revenue for the first half of 2026 were RMB 60.7 billion or USD 8.9 billion, representing a 7% increase year-over-year. For the second quarter, total revenue were RMB 30.1 billion or USD 4.4 billion. During the first half, total net revenue from our games and related VAS were RMB 15.7 billion, up 8% year-over-year. In the second quarter, net revenue grew 10% to reach RMB 25 billion. Specifically, net revenue from online games were RMB 49.5 billion for the first half, up 9% year-over-year. In the second quarter, online games net revenue were RMB 24.5 billion, decreasing 2% quarter-over-quarter and increasing 10% year-over-year. The quarter-over-quarter decrease were mainly due to a slight decline in net revenue from certain self-developed games and licensed games. The year-over-year increase was attributable to higher net revenue from self-development games such as Fantasy Westward Journey franchise and Where Winds Meet. Youdao's net revenue increased 4% to RMB 2.8 billion for the first half of 2026. In the second quarter, net revenue were RMB 1.5 billion, up 9% quarter-over-quarter and 3% year-over-year. The quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year increases were mainly attributable to higher net revenue from its learning services segment. NetEase Cloud Music net revenue increased 3% year-over-year to RMB 4.0 billion for the first half of 2026. In the second quarter, net revenues were RMB 2 billion, remaining broadly stable quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year. Net revenues from the innovative business and others totaled RMB 3.2 billion for the first half of 2026. In the second quarter, net revenue were RMB 1.6 billion, up 6% quarter-over-quarter and down 4% year-over-year. The quarter-over-quarter increase was mainly attributable to higher net revenue from the e-commerce business and several other business within this segment. The year-over-year decrease was mainly due to a modest decline in net revenue from the e-commerce business. For the first half, our gross profit margin was 69.9%. In the second quarter, our gross profit margin increased year-over-year to 70.5% from 64.7% in the prior year period. Looking at our second quarter margin in more detail. Gross profit margin was 76.1% from our games and related VAS compared with 70.2% in the same period of last year. The improvement was primarily driven by lower revenue sharing costs related to platforms. Our gross profit margin for Youdao was 48.9% compared with 43.0% in the same period of last year. The increase was mainly driven by improved gross profit margin from its learning services segment. Gross profit margin for Cloud Music was 37.4% compared with 36.1% in the same period last year. The increase was primarily driven by lower channel fee rates, along with the continued cost structure optimization. For our innovative business and others, gross profit margin was 43.4% compared with 42.3% in the second quarter of 2025. The improvement was primarily driven by the higher contribution from higher-margin business within this segment. Total operating expenses for the second quarter were RMB 9.1 billion, representing 30% of our total net revenue. Taking a closer look at our expense composition. Our selling and marketing expenses accounted for 12.2% of total net revenue in the second quarter compared with 12.8% in the same period of last year, remaining generally stable year-over-year. For the first half, the ratio was 11.7%, remaining broadly in line with the same period last year. Our G&A expenses accounted for 2.7% of total net revenues in the second quarter compared with 3.8% in the same period of last year. For the first half, the ratio was 2.4% compared with 3.5% in the same period of last year. Our R&D expenses remained stable at 15.4% of total net revenues in the second quarter compared with 15.6% in the same period of last year, reflecting our consistent investment in innovation and content development. For the first half, the ratio was 15.0%, remaining broadly in line with the same period of last year. The effective tax rate was 21.7% for the first half and 25.5% for the second quarter. As a reminder, the effective tax rate is presented on an accrual basis and the tax credit vary across each of our entities at different time periods depending on applicable policies and our operations. Our non-GAAP net income attributable to shareholders for the second quarter totaled RMB 7.7 billion or USD 1.1 billion, with the year-over-year decline primarily attributable to investment losses. Non-GAAP basic earnings per ADS for the quarter was USD 1.78 or USD 0.36 per share. For the first half, non-GAAP net income attributable to shareholders was down 8% year-over-year to RMB 19 billion or USD 2.8 billion, which is USD 4.38 per ADS or USD 0.88 per share. Additionally, our cash position remains strong. As of June 30, 2026, our total net cash position was RMB 167.5 billion compared with RMB 163.5 billion at the end of 2025. In accordance with our dividend policy, we are pleased to report that our Board of Directors has approved a dividend of USD 0.096 per share or USD 0.48 per ADS for the second quarter. Lastly, under our current USD 5 billion share repurchase program, we have repurchased approximately 24.8 million ADS as of June 30, 2026, for a total cost of approximately USD 2.3 billion. Thank you for your attention. We would now like to open the call to your questions.
Operator: [Operator Instructions] The first question comes from Alicia Yap with Citigroup.
Alicis a Yap: [Foreign Language] [Interpreted] So can management share the latest performance of and also the expected closing for the next quarter? What aspects are currently doing well? And then what adjustments are planned in the future to further improve the games performance?
William Ding: [Foreign Language]
Bill Pang: [Interpreted] Okay. I will do the translation. So in China market, we did receive a lot of user feedback and among which certain amount are critics. Review what we -- all the feedback we received, we realized that while we are trying to explore a very bold visual style and the rogue gameplay, which is the kind of novel open world experience, we did not sufficiently lower the learning curve for players in the early stages, which, to some extent, affected the initial player experience. So that's feedback we have heard and taken. So in the meantime, our team has prepared a substantial amount of large high-quality amount of content and which provide the foundation of the long-term operation and sustainable player community operation. After this initial feedback round, along with the high cadence of content update and experience optimization, we believe we have seen growing recognition from the players group of the games core gameplay and content quality, which with discussions back to the game's content and ongoing operations, the overall sentiment and satisfaction has continued to improve. Looking ahead, we'll continue to serve our core players of this game well and keep optimization -- keep optimizing the experience problems we heard from players. In the meantime, we will streamline the early-stage game content, make sure the innovative game play could be better and wider accepted and experienced by the players. We are confident in the long-term potential of this game. Thank you for your question.
Operator: The next question comes from Xueqing Zhang with CICC.
Xueqing Zhang: [Foreign Language] I will translate my question. [Interpreted] Could management update us on the development progress of Ananta with several competing titles targeting the urban open world genre. How does the company plan to differentiate the game and stand out from the competition?
William Ding: [Foreign Language]
Bill Pang: [Interpreted] Okay. I will do the translation. Ananta is well on track with its development as the team is now keep polishing the game experience. We'll unveil the game's latest progress at the Gamescom next week. So please stay tuned. In terms of competition, we believe Ananta has its own distinctive strength as an urban open world experience. The strength come from the product's unique identity, its theme and its gameplay design as well, which can offer players a fresh experience that stands apart from other open world urban games in the market. Ultimately, we believe that the high-quality content, the distinctive narrative identity, the innovative gameplay and thoughtful monetization design will be the key to build a successful -- to being a key part of the -- behind the success of products. Thank you for your question.
Operator: Your next question comes from Lincoln Kong with Goldman Sachs.
Lincoln Kong: [Foreign Language] [Interpreted] Congrats on a very solid second quarter. So over the past 1 or 2 years, actually, the company proactively reduced the number of new game launches to focus the resources on the key titles. And meanwhile, like a new release like Marvel Rivals delivered a very strong performance. So looking ahead with a relatively lean pipeline of new games and the higher baseline for our existing portfolio, how does the company plan to drive further business growth? So what will be the primary growth driver and operating strategy moving forward?
William Ding: [Foreign Language]
Bill Pang: [Interpreted] Okay. I will help do the transition. Well, first of all, regarding the really high-quality products, we're not hesitated to keep investment in. And we're actually going to keep investing to keep building really high quality level of premium products, good premium quality of products. Of course, when doing new products, we need to make sure that we have a clear vision as well as making sure the quality is definitely top notch. And secondly, now as of today, with the help of AI capabilities, which we believe is an amplifier that we believe we can expedite the development speed and as well as leveraging AI capabilities to improve the user experience when users playing our game. We have confidence that with the help of AI tools, we can build more high-quality products than most of our peers in the industry, providing a high-quality experience to our players. That's something we have confidence in, and that's our view. And thank you for your question.
Operator: Your next question comes from Ritchie Sun with HSBC.
Ritchie Sun: [Foreign Language] [Interpreted] So recently, the 2 games undergoing testing, Beneath The Mist and also Tamas: Shadowveil. So how does management view the monetization potential of these 2 games? And when can these games be launched?
William Ding: [Foreign Language]
Bill Pang: [Interpreted] I will do the translation. So thank you for your question. Both of the products you mentioned are still ongoing intensive refinement. And one is refinements approach a stage that we believe will satisfy the users' demand and we will release them. As the game developer, we believe player experience is the key of everything. We believe delivering an excellent experience is the foundation of achieving commercial success. Thank you for your question.
Operator: And that concludes the question-and-answer session. I would like to turn the conference back over to Brandi Piacente for any additional or closing comments. Brandi, please go ahead with your closing comments.
Brandi Piacente: Thank you. Sorry for that. Thank you once again for joining us today. And if you have any further questions, please feel free to contact us. Thank you again.
Operator: This concludes the conference. You may disconnect your line. Thank you. [Portions of this transcript that are marked [Interpreted] were spoken by an interpreter present on the live call.]

report.description_zh: 網易公司在中華人民共和國及國際市場提供廣泛的線上服務，涵蓋內容、社群互動、通訊及電子商務等多元領域。其業務分為四大主要板塊：線上遊戲服務、有道、雲音樂以及創新業務及其他。該公司開發並營運自有電腦及手機遊戲，同時也發行其他開發商授權的遊戲。有道板塊專注於教育科技，提供有道詞典和U-Dictionary等數位知識與翻譯工具，以及詞典筆和智慧檯燈等智慧學習設備。此板塊亦提供線上課程、互動學習應用程式，以及企業解決方案，包括針對學校的AI驅動有道智慧學習終端和用於進階光學字元辨識及神經機器翻譯的有道智慧雲。網易雲音樂是其雲音樂板塊的核心，作為一個受歡迎的音樂串流平台營運。創新業務及其他板塊包括嚴選（一個銷售自有品牌通用商品的電子商務平台）、網易傳媒（一個網路媒體平台）、網易郵箱（提供電子郵件服務）、網易CC直播（一個主要用於遊戲內容的直播平台），以及網易支付（一個支付服務）。該公司於一九九七年成立，總部位於中華人民共和國杭州，並於二零一二年三月將公司名稱從NetEase.com, Inc.更改為NetEase, Inc。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 網易公司展現出多方面的經濟護城河特徵，尤其在遊戲、教育科技和音樂串流領域。其強大的品牌認知度、廣泛的用戶基礎以及社群互動，為其產品創造了顯著的轉換成本和網路效應。公司持續投入創新，特別是在遊戲開發和AI技術應用方面，有助於維持其市場競爭力。儘管在某些領域缺乏明確的專利或監管優勢證據，但其在內容生態系統和營運效率上的表現，支持了其長期價值創造的能力。本評估為人工智慧基於公開資訊的定性判斷，並非財務測量結果，且可能受限於可用證據的範圍。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: NetEase, Inc. demonstrates several economic moat characteristics, particularly in its gaming, education technology, and music streaming segments. Strong brand recognition, a broad user base, and community engagement create significant switching costs and network effects for its products. The company's continuous investment in innovation, especially in game development and AI technology, helps maintain its market competitiveness. While explicit evidence for patents or regulatory advantages is less clear in some areas, its performance in content ecosystems and operational efficiency supports its long-term value creation capabilities. This assessment represents an AI's qualitative judgment based on publicly available information, not a financial measurement, and may be limited by the scope of available evidence.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 公司旗下多款遊戲，如《夢幻西遊》和《蛋仔派對》，擁有龐大的用戶基礎和持續的社群活躍度，顯示出強大的品牌吸引力。有道詞典筆連續多年在電商平台銷售領先，網易雲音樂也強調用戶體驗和品牌認知，這些都表明公司在不同業務領域建立了穩固的品牌形象和一定的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The company's games, such as Fantasy Westward Journey and Eggy Party, boast large user bases and sustained community engagement, indicating strong brand appeal. Youdao Dictionary Pen has consistently led sales on e-commerce platforms for years, and NetEase Cloud Music emphasizes user experience and brand perception. These factors suggest the company has built a solid brand image and some pricing power across its diverse business segments.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司業務涉及遊戲授權和教育科技的AI應用，但公開資料中未明確提及具體的專利組合或獨特的監管許可。雖然遊戲產業常依賴智慧財產權，但缺乏關於專利保護或監管壁壘的詳細說明，因此難以評估此維度的護城河強度。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: While the company's business involves game licensing and AI applications in education technology, the public information does not explicitly mention specific patent portfolios or unique regulatory licenses. Although the gaming industry often relies on intellectual property, the absence of detailed descriptions regarding patent protection or regulatory barriers makes it difficult to assess the strength of this moat dimension.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司透過持續更新遊戲內容、強化社群功能以及提供個性化服務，有效提升了用戶的轉換成本。例如，《夢幻西遊》和《永劫無間》的長期營運與內容迭代，以及網易雲音樂的會員忠誠度提升，都使得用戶難以輕易轉向其他平台。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company effectively increases user switching costs through continuous game content updates, enhanced community features, and personalized services. For instance, the long-term operation and content iterations of Fantasy Westward Journey and NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, along with increased membership loyalty for NetEase Cloud Music, make it difficult for users to easily switch to other platforms.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 《蛋仔派對》擁有龐大的註冊用戶和活躍用戶，以及蓬勃發展的用戶生成內容生態系統，這強烈表明了網路效應的存在。網易雲音樂的活躍音樂社群和社群內容消費互動，以及《永劫無間》整合跨平台玩家社群的努力，都顯示出隨著用戶數量增加，產品價值也隨之提升。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: Eggy Party's massive registered user base, high monthly active users, and thriving user-generated content ecosystem strongly indicate the presence of network effects. NetEase Cloud Music's vibrant music community and community content consumption interactions, along with NARAKA: BLADEPOINT's efforts to unify its cross-platform player community, all demonstrate that the product's value increases as its user base grows.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 公司在多個業務板塊擁有龐大的用戶基礎和營運規模，這有助於實現規模經濟，降低單位成本。遊戲業務毛利率的提升得益於平台分成成本的降低，而有道和雲音樂的毛利率改善則歸因於成本結構優化，這些都反映了公司在成本控制和規模效益方面的優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company's large user base and operational scale across multiple business segments contribute to economies of scale, reducing per-unit costs. Improved gross profit margins in the games business are due to lower platform revenue sharing costs, while Youdao and Cloud Music's margin improvements stem from cost structure optimization. These factors reflect the company's advantages in cost control and scale efficiency.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 公開資料中未提及公司擁有任何獨特的地理位置或實體資產，其業務性質主要為數位服務。因此，無法評估此維度對其護城河的貢獻。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The public information does not mention any unique geographical locations or physical assets owned by the company, as its business nature is primarily digital services. Therefore, it is not possible to assess the contribution of this dimension to its economic moat.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司持續投入研發，並在各業務板塊展現出穩健的毛利率和營運現金流。遊戲業務的毛利率提升歸因於平台分成成本降低，有道和雲音樂的毛利率改善則來自成本結構優化，這些都表明公司在營運上具備效率，能夠有效管理成本並產生穩定的收益。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company consistently invests in research and development and demonstrates robust gross profit margins and operating cash flows across its business segments. The improvement in gross profit margins for the games business is attributed to lower platform revenue sharing costs, while Youdao and Cloud Music's margin improvements stem from cost structure optimization. These indicate operational efficiency, effective cost management, and consistent revenue generation.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司透過股票回購和派發股息向股東回報資本，同時也持續投資於新遊戲開發和AI技術應用。管理層強調對高品質產品的持續投入，並利用AI加速開發和提升用戶體驗，這顯示出其在戰略資產配置上的深思熟慮，旨在創造長期價值。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company returns capital to shareholders through share repurchases and dividend payments, while also continuously investing in new game development and AI technology applications. Management emphasizes ongoing investment in high-quality products and leveraging AI to accelerate development and enhance user experience, demonstrating a thoughtful approach to strategic asset allocation aimed at creating long-term value.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司多款遊戲，如《夢幻西遊》和《永劫無間》，透過不斷的內容更新和社群活動，保持了玩家的長期參與。網易雲音樂的用戶留存率和續訂率持續提升，有道的AI功能也增強了用戶滿意度和留存。這些都表明公司在抵禦技術和需求變革方面具有較強的客戶黏性。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Several of the company's games, such as Fantasy Westward Journey and NARAKA: BLADEPOINT, maintain long-term player engagement through continuous content updates and community activities. NetEase Cloud Music shows improving user retention and renewal rates, and Youdao's AI features enhance user satisfaction and retention. These factors indicate strong customer stickiness in resisting technological and demand disruptions.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司管理層強調創新、長期營運和適應玩家不斷變化的期望，並持續投入研發和高品質產品。利用AI技術提升開發效率和用戶體驗的策略，顯示出公司對業務長期可持續發展的承諾，有助於維持其競爭優勢。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company's management emphasizes innovation, long-term operations, and adapting to evolving player expectations, with continuous investment in R&D and high-quality products. The strategy of leveraging AI technology to enhance development efficiency and user experience demonstrates the company's commitment to long-term business sustainability, which helps maintain its competitive advantage.

profile.description: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation operates as an investment holding entity, primarily focused on the computer-aided design, production, evaluation, assembly, and distribution of integrated circuits (ICs). Its market presence extends across North America, China, the wider Asian region, Hong Kong, and Eurasia. The company also engages in the technical research, development, manufacturing, and sale of semiconductor masks, in addition to offering semiconductor foundry and technological services. Furthermore, it is involved in the construction, operation, and management of residential accommodations. SMIC provides comprehensive 'one-stop' support, encompassing design, intellectual property assistance, and photomask manufacturing, alongside marketing and private educational services. Incorporated in 2000, its corporate headquarters are situated in Shanghai, People's Republic of China.

report.description_zh: 中芯國際集成電路製造有限公司作為一家投資控股實體運營，主要專注於積體電路（IC）的電腦輔助設計、生產、評估、組裝和分銷。其市場業務遍及北美、中國、更廣泛的亞洲地區、香港和歐亞大陸。該公司還從事半導體光罩的技術研究、開發、製造和銷售，並提供半導體代工和技術服務。此外，它還參與住宅住宿的建設、運營和管理。中芯國際提供全面的「一站式」支援，包括設計、智慧財產權協助和光罩製造，以及市場行銷和私人教育服務。該公司於二零零零年註冊成立，其公司總部設於中華人民共和國上海。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 中芯國際在半導體代工領域展現出顯著的護城河特徵，主要體現在客戶轉換成本高昂以及規模經濟帶來的成本優勢。其在技術研發和智慧財產權方面的投入，以及建立和維護高度專業化製造設施所需的巨額資本，構成了難以複製的戰略資產。然而，在品牌定價能力、網路效應和獨特地理資產方面，證據相對有限。此外，由於缺乏管理層誠信和資本配置品質的詳細資訊，以及無法計算關鍵的資本回報指標，這些方面的護城河強度難以評估。本評估基於有限的公開資料，所有分數均為人工智慧的定性判斷，而非財務測量。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: SMIC exhibits notable moat characteristics in the semiconductor foundry sector, primarily driven by high customer switching costs and cost advantages derived from economies of scale. Its investments in technological R&D and intellectual property, coupled with the substantial capital required to establish and maintain highly specialized manufacturing facilities, constitute strategic assets that are difficult to reproduce. However, evidence for brand pricing power, network effects, and unique geographical assets is relatively limited. Furthermore, due to the lack of detailed information on management integrity and capital allocation quality, and the inability to calculate key capital return metrics, the strength of the moat in these areas is difficult to assess. This assessment is based on limited public data, and all scores represent AI qualitative judgment, not financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 該公司作為半導體代工廠，其品牌實力主要源於技術能力和可靠性，而非消費者認知。雖然提供一站式服務，但缺乏明確證據表明其品牌能帶來顯著的定價優勢。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: As a semiconductor foundry, the company's brand strength primarily stems from its technical capabilities and reliability, rather than consumer recognition. While it offers one-stop services, there is no clear evidence to suggest its brand commands significant pricing power.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 半導體產業高度依賴專利和智慧財產權。公司業務涉及技術研發和光罩製造，並提供智慧財產權協助，這表明專利和監管許可在其營運中扮演著重要角色。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The semiconductor industry is highly dependent on patents and intellectual property. The company's business involves technical research and development, photomask manufacturing, and intellectual property assistance, indicating that patents and regulatory licenses play a significant role in its operations.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 作為半導體代工廠，公司提供全面的技術服務和一站式支援。客戶一旦將設計與特定製程整合，轉換代工廠將涉及高昂的重新設計、驗證和資格認證成本，因此客戶轉換成本很高。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: As a semiconductor foundry, the company provides comprehensive technological services and one-stop support. Once customers integrate their designs with a specific process, switching foundries would incur significant re-design, validation, and re-qualification costs, leading to high switching costs for clients.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 公司業務主要為半導體製造和技術服務，描述中沒有提及任何平台或服務會因使用者數量增加而提升其價值，因此缺乏網路效應的證據。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The company's business primarily involves semiconductor manufacturing and technological services. The description does not mention any platform or service whose value increases with the number of users, thus lacking evidence of network effects.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 半導體製造是資本密集型產業，規模經濟對於降低成本至關重要。公司在全球範圍內營運，並持續進行巨額資本支出，這表明其透過大規模生產和投資來實現成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: Semiconductor manufacturing is a capital-intensive industry where economies of scale are crucial for cost reduction. The company operates globally and consistently makes substantial capital expenditures, indicating its pursuit of cost advantages through large-scale production and investment.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 公司業務遍及全球多個地區，但半導體製造設施並非依賴獨特的地理位置來獲得競爭優勢。描述中沒有提及任何稀有或不可複製的地理資產，能形成自然寡佔。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The company operates across multiple global regions, but semiconductor manufacturing facilities do not rely on unique geographical locations for competitive advantage. The description does not mention any rare or irreproducible geographical assets that could form a natural oligopoly.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 評估持續的資本回報需要比較投資資本回報率與加權平均資本成本，但此處無法計算。雖然公司有盈利，但在資本密集型產業中，其營運利潤率並未顯示出卓越的營運效率能帶來持續優異的資本回報。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: Assessing sustained capital returns requires comparing Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) with the Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), which cannot be calculated here. While the company is profitable, its operating margins in a capital-intensive industry do not indicate exceptional operational efficiency leading to sustained superior capital returns.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司持續投入巨額資本支出於半導體製造設施和技術研發，這些高度專業化的資產和複雜的製程技術是其核心競爭力。這些戰略性資產的建立和複製極其困難，需要龐大的資金和專業知識。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company continuously invests massive capital expenditures in semiconductor manufacturing facilities and technological R&D. These highly specialized assets and complex process technologies are its core competitive advantages. The creation and reproduction of these strategic assets are extremely difficult, requiring immense capital and expertise.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 儘管高轉換成本有助於客戶保留，但半導體產業面臨快速的技術變革和需求波動。公司提供設計和智慧財產權協助，並進行技術研發，顯示其努力適應變化，但產業本質上容易受到顛覆。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: While high switching costs aid customer retention, the semiconductor industry faces rapid technological change and demand fluctuations. The company provides design and intellectual property assistance, along with technical R&D, indicating efforts to adapt to changes, but the industry is inherently prone to disruption.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 評估管理層的誠信和資本配置品質需要更多關於公司治理、管理層歷史決策和長期戰略的資訊。儘管有財務數據，但缺乏足夠的證據來判斷管理層的誠信或資本配置的優劣。
m10_durability.comment_en: Assessing management integrity and capital allocation quality requires more information on corporate governance, management's historical decisions, and long-term strategies. Despite financial data, there is insufficient evidence to judge management's integrity or the quality of capital allocation.

profile.description: Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily dedicated to the entire lifecycle of optical and related products, as well as scientific instruments. This encompasses their design, research, development, manufacturing, and sales. The company's offerings are structured into three main divisions: 1. Optical Components: This segment manufactures various types of lenses, including spherical and aspherical glass lenses, along with specialized lens sets for mobile devices, automotive applications, and security surveillance systems. 2. Optoelectronic Products: This division provides camera modules for handsets, vehicle systems, three-dimensional optoelectronic solutions, and other integrated optoelectronic modules. 3. Optical Instruments: Here, the company delivers precision tools such as microscopes and intelligent inspection equipment. Sunny Optical's advanced optoelectronic products are extensively utilized across diverse sectors, including mobile phones, digital cameras, automotive imaging and sensing systems, security surveillance, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR) platforms, and robotics. Their sophisticated functionality stems from an intricate integration of optical, electronic, algorithmic, and mechanical technologies. Beyond its core manufacturing and sales, the company is also involved in the research and development of infrared and semiconductor technologies. Additional operations include the trading of optical instruments and optoelectronic goods, property leasing, technology development and consulting services, financial services, and import/export agency services. The company maintains a significant operational footprint, predominantly in the People's Republic of China, with a broad reach extending throughout the rest of Asia, Europe, North America, and other international markets. Founded in 1984, its corporate headquarters are situated in Yuyao, China.

Ma Jianfeng: [Interpreted] Ladies and gentle gentlemen, good morning. On behalf of the company, I would like to report to you the first half of the year our operating performance and outlook. So first of all is our financial overview. In the first half of this year benefited from smartphones recovery, especially our headset lens and headset modules had optimized its structure and therefore the revenue in the first half of the year is RMB 18.8 billion increased by 32.1%. The gross margin RMB 3.4 billion increased by 52%. Profit before tax RMB 1.2 billion increased by 111%. Profits attributable to the owners of the company RMB 1.79 billion increased by 147%. By categories, sales, selling and distribution account for -- went down by 0.5% R&D expenditure increased by 7.8% and administrative expenses remained just relatively stable at 3%. So we want to keep that expenses down to 12% of the total revenue. Now we have a very solid financial position. The key indicators current ratio stabilizes at what operating cash inflow RMB 2.06 billion net cash per share RMB 1.29 thousand and gearing ratio 12.1%. ROE increased to 4.7%. CapEx in the first half of the year is RMB 1.04 billion. Revenue breakdown by product applications. The biggest chunk comes from handset related product accounting to 69% slightly increased and handset related product down by 0.3%, because it went up slowly than other categories. report.description_zh: 舜宇光學科技（集團）有限公司作為一家投資控股公司，主要致力於光學及相關產品以及科學儀器的整個生命週期，包括其設計、研究、開發、製造和銷售。該公司的產品分為三大主要部門：1. 光學零件：此部門製造各種類型的鏡頭，包括球面和非球面玻璃鏡頭，以及用於移動設備、汽車應用和安全監控系統的專用鏡頭組。2. 光電產品：此部門提供手機攝像模組、車載系統、三維光電解決方案及其他集成光電模組。3. 光學儀器：在此部門，公司提供顯微鏡和智能檢測設備等精密工具。舜宇光學的先進光電產品廣泛應用於多個領域，包括手機、數碼相機、汽車影像和傳感系統、安全監控、虛擬實境/擴增實境（VR/AR）平台以及機器人技術。其複雜的功能源於光學、電子、算法和機械技術的精妙整合。除了核心製造和銷售業務外，公司還涉足紅外線和半導體技術的研究與開發。其他業務包括光學儀器和光電產品貿易、物業租賃、技術開發和諮詢服務、金融服務以及進出口代理服務。公司在中華人民共和國擁有重要的營運足跡，業務範圍廣泛，遍及亞洲其他地區、歐洲、北美及其他國際市場。公司成立於一九八四年，總部設於中國餘姚。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 舜宇光學科技在光學產品領域展現出顯著的競爭優勢，尤其在專利保護、規模經濟和客戶深度整合方面表現突出。公司在手機鏡頭和模組市場佔據領先地位，並積極拓展車載和XR等新興高增長領域。持續的研發投入和產品組合優化策略有助於提升盈利能力和市場地位。然而，部分護城河維度，如網絡效應和獨特地理資產，缺乏明確證據支持。整體評估為人工智慧的定性判斷，並非財務測量。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Sunny Optical Technology demonstrates significant competitive advantages in the optical products sector, particularly in patent protection, economies of scale, and deep customer integration. The company holds a leading position in the handset lens and module markets and is actively expanding into new high-growth areas like automotive and XR. Continuous R&D investment and product mix optimization strategies contribute to enhanced profitability and market standing. However, some moat dimensions, such as network effects and unique geographical assets, lack clear supporting evidence. This overall assessment represents an AI's qualitative judgment and is not a financial measurement.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 公司在手機鏡頭和模組市場保持領先地位，並透過優化產品組合，特別是高階產品，來提升平均銷售價格和毛利率。在某些先進鏡頭組方面，公司是獨家供應商，顯示其在特定利基市場的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The company maintains a leading position in the handset lens and module markets, enhancing average selling prices and gross margins through product mix optimization, especially with higher-end offerings. As the sole supplier for certain advanced lens sets, the company demonstrates pricing power in specific niche markets.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司擁有大量的發明專利和實用新型專利，主要集中在其核心產品領域，如手機、鏡頭組、XR和機器人視覺相關技術。這表明公司在技術創新和知識產權保護方面投入巨大，形成了強大的進入壁壘。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company possesses a substantial number of invention and utility model patents, primarily concentrated in its core product areas such as handsets, lens sets, XR, and robotic vision technologies. This indicates significant investment in technological innovation and intellectual property protection, creating strong barriers to entry.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司與主要客戶建立了深度合作關係，業務日益緊密。特別是在車載產品領域，產品生命週期較長，一旦客戶採用其模組，轉換供應商的成本和複雜性較高，為公司帶來穩定的業務。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company has established deep and increasingly intertwined cooperation with its major clients. Particularly in the automotive product sector, where product lifecycles are extended, the cost and complexity for clients to switch suppliers once modules are adopted are considerable, contributing to stable business for the company.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 現有證據未明確指出公司產品或服務的價值會隨著更多用戶的加入而增加，因此無法評估網絡效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The available evidence does not clearly indicate that the value of the company's products or services increases with a growing user base, thus network effects cannot be assessed.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 公司在多個產品類別中位居全球領先地位，擁有龐大的生產規模和全球營運足跡，包括在越南的大型生產基地。這使其能夠透過規模經濟降低成本，並透過產品創新（如玻璃塑膠混合鏡頭）進一步優化成本結構。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company holds a global leading position in several product categories, benefiting from extensive production scale and a global operational footprint, including large manufacturing bases in Vietnam. This enables cost reduction through economies of scale and further cost structure optimization via product innovations like glass-plastic hybrid lenses.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 儘管公司在全球範圍內擁有廣泛的營運足跡和生產基地，但現有證據並未描述任何獨特的地理位置或資產，能夠創造自然寡頭壟斷或難以複製的競爭優勢。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: While the company possesses a broad operational footprint and production bases globally, the available evidence does not describe any unique geographical locations or assets that create a natural oligopoly or an irreplicable competitive advantage.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司報告毛利率和營運收入有所改善，並致力於優化結構和控制費用。在生產線上，例如後處理檢測環節，實現了顯著的效率提升。這些跡象表明公司在營運效率方面表現良好。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company has reported improvements in gross margins and operating income, alongside efforts to optimize its structure and control expenses. Significant efficiency gains have been achieved in production lines, such as post-processing inspection. These indicators suggest strong operational efficiency.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司持續投入研發，以開發車載、XR和機器人視覺等新興領域的產品，並擴大生產能力。管理層強調即使面臨挑戰，也需投資研發以保持競爭力，這反映了其對長期戰略資產的重視和審慎的資本配置。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company consistently invests in research and development to create products for emerging fields such as automotive, XR, and robotic vision, while also expanding production capacity. Management emphasizes the necessity of R&D investment to maintain competitiveness, even amidst challenges, reflecting a focus on long-term strategic assets and prudent capital allocation.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司與主要客戶的深度整合，特別是車載產品的長生命週期，有助於穩固客戶關係。透過持續的研發和技術創新，公司能夠滿足客戶不斷變化的需求，並因其能力和技術獲得客戶認可，有效抵禦技術和需求變革的衝擊。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Deep integration with major clients, especially the long lifecycle of automotive products, helps solidify customer relationships. Through continuous R&D and technological innovation, the company meets evolving client demands and gains recognition for its capabilities and technology, effectively resisting technological and demand disruptions.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司自成立以來擁有悠久的營運歷史，並透過持續的研發投入、戰略性地多元化進入車載和XR等新興市場，以及對ESG表現的承諾，展現出對長期可持續發展的重視。管理層在平衡市場份額和盈利能力方面的討論，也體現了其戰略眼光。
m10_durability.comment_en: With a long operating history since its founding, the company demonstrates a commitment to long-term sustainability through continuous R&D investment, strategic diversification into emerging markets like automotive and XR, and dedication to ESG performance. Management's discussions on balancing market share and profitability also reflect its strategic foresight.

profile.description: Operating as an investment holding entity, BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited is centrally involved in crafting and supplying parts and integrated modules for mobile handsets. Its commercial footprint extends across the People's Republic of China and into international markets. The firm also furnishes high-level assembly solutions. In addition to mobile device components, its extensive product line encompasses various batteries and charging apparatuses, with a particular emphasis on iron phosphate batteries—and their associated components and spare parts—engineered for electric vehicles such as buses, trucks, cars, and industrial forklifts. Diversifying its portfolio, the company also undertakes the development and ongoing maintenance of monorail projects. Established in 1995, BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited's principal office is located in Shenzhen, China, and it functions as a subsidiary of Golden Link Worldwide Limited.

report.description_zh: 比亞迪電子（國際）有限公司作為一家投資控股實體，主要從事移動手機零部件和集成模組的製造與供應。其業務範圍遍及中華人民共和國及國際市場。該公司還提供高階組裝解決方案。除了移動設備組件，其廣泛的產品線還包括各種電池和充電設備，特別是專為電動巴士、卡車、汽車和工業叉車等電動車輛設計的磷酸鐵鋰電池及其相關組件和備件。為實現業務多元化，該公司還承擔單軌項目的開發和持續維護。比亞迪電子（國際）有限公司成立於一九九五年，主要辦事處位於中國深圳，是Golden Link Worldwide Limited的子公司。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 本評估基於有限的公開資料，主要來自公司簡介和財務數據，未包含任何電話會議記錄。比亞迪電子（國際）有限公司在規模和成本方面可能具有一定的優勢，並且其專業產品和基礎設施項目可能為客戶帶來轉換成本。然而，在品牌定價能力、專利保護、網絡效應、獨特地理資產、營運效率、資本配置以及抵禦技術和需求變化的能力方面，現有證據不足以支持其擁有顯著的經濟護城河。管理層誠信和資本配置的耐久性也缺乏相關資訊。所有護城河評分均為人工智慧的定性判斷，而非財務測量結果。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: This assessment is based on limited public information, primarily from the company profile and financial data, without any earnings call transcripts. BYD Electronic (International) Company Limited may possess some advantages in scale and cost, and its specialized products and infrastructure projects could create switching costs for clients. However, there is insufficient evidence to support significant economic moats in brand pricing power, patent protection, network effects, unique geographical assets, operational efficiency, capital allocation, or resistance to technological and demand disruption. Information regarding management integrity and the durability of capital allocation is also absent. All moat scores represent qualitative judgments by artificial intelligence, not reported financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 該公司作為移動手機零部件和電動車電池的供應商，其品牌影響力主要體現在與企業客戶的關係上，而非消費者認知。近年來毛利率呈現下降趨勢，這可能表明其在定價方面面臨壓力，或市場競爭激烈，未能展現出強大的定價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: As a supplier of mobile handset components and EV batteries, the company's brand influence primarily resides in its relationships with corporate clients rather than consumer recognition. A declining trend in gross profit margins in recent periods may indicate pricing pressure or intense market competition, suggesting a lack of strong pricing power.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 儘管公司業務涉及電動車電池和單軌項目等可能需要專利和監管許可的領域，但現有資料並未明確提及公司擁有任何具體的專利、許可證或受監管保護的優勢。因此，無法對此護城河維度進行評分。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: Although the company operates in sectors such as EV batteries and monorail projects, which may involve patents and regulatory licenses, the provided information does not explicitly mention any specific patents, licenses, or regulatory protections that benefit the company. Therefore, this moat dimension cannot be scored.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司為移動手機提供高階組裝解決方案，並為電動車輛設計磷酸鐵鋰電池，這些專業產品和服務可能要求客戶投入大量資源進行整合和測試。此外，單軌項目作為基礎設施建設，其長期性和複雜性也意味著客戶轉換供應商的成本會非常高昂。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company provides high-level assembly solutions for mobile handsets and engineers iron phosphate batteries for electric vehicles. These specialized products and services likely require significant client investment in integration and testing. Furthermore, monorail projects, being infrastructure developments, imply high switching costs for clients due to their long-term and complex nature.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 根據公司作為零部件供應商、組裝解決方案提供商和電池製造商的業務模式，沒有跡象表明其產品或服務的價值會隨著用戶數量的增加而提升。因此，現有資料無法支持存在網絡效應護城河。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: Based on the company's business model as a component supplier, assembly solutions provider, and battery manufacturer, there is no indication that the value of its products or services increases with the number of users. Therefore, the available data does not support the presence of a network effects moat.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 公司在移動手機零部件和電動車電池領域的廣泛產品線和龐大營收規模，表明其在採購、生產和分銷方面可能享有顯著的規模經濟。作為主要供應商，其大規模運營有助於實現成本效率，從而獲得一定的成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company's extensive product line in mobile handset components and EV batteries, coupled with its substantial revenue, suggests it likely benefits from significant economies of scale in procurement, production, and distribution. Its large-scale operations as a major supplier contribute to cost efficiencies, providing a degree of cost advantage.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 公司業務遍及中國及國際市場，並未顯示出任何獨特的地理位置優勢。儘管單軌項目可能涉及地方性壟斷，但描述中沒有提供足夠的細節來評估其是否構成獨特的地理資產或自然寡頭壟斷。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The company operates across China and international markets, which does not indicate any unique geographical advantage. While monorail projects might involve local monopolies, the description lacks sufficient detail to assess whether this constitutes a unique geographical asset or a natural oligopoly.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 雖然公司持續產生正向的經營收入，但其經營收入相對於總資產的比例呈現下降趨勢。在缺乏資本成本資訊的情況下，無法判斷其是否實現了持續優於平均水平的資本回報，因此無法對營運效率護城河進行評分。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: While the company consistently generates positive operating income, its operating income relative to total assets shows a declining trend. Without information on the cost of capital, it is not possible to determine if it achieves sustained superior returns on capital, thus preventing a score for operational efficiency moat.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司在資本支出方面投入顯著，並產生了正向的自由現金流，這表明其有能力進行再投資和回報股東。然而，現有資料並未提供關於管理層如何分配資本以創造難以複製的戰略資產的具體資訊，因此無法評估此維度。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company makes significant capital expenditures and generates positive free cash flow, indicating its ability to reinvest and return capital to shareholders. However, the available data does not provide specific information on how management allocates capital to create irreproducible strategic assets, making it impossible to assess this dimension.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司所處的移動設備和電動車電池行業技術變革迅速，需求波動較大。儘管業務多元化可能提供一定緩衝，但現有資料並未提供關於客戶忠誠度計劃、長期合同細節或公司如何積極應對技術和需求顛覆的具體證據，因此無法評分。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: The mobile device and EV battery industries in which the company operates are subject to rapid technological change and demand fluctuations. While business diversification may offer some buffer, the available data does not provide specific evidence of customer loyalty programs, detailed long-term contracts, or how the company actively resists technological and demand disruption, thus preventing a score.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 現有資料僅包含財務報表和公司簡介，缺乏關於管理層誠信、公司治理結構或其資本配置決策質量的具體資訊。因此，無法對管理層誠信和資本配置的耐久性這一護城河維度進行評估。
m10_durability.comment_en: The available data, consisting solely of financial statements and a company profile, lacks specific information regarding management integrity, corporate governance structures, or the quality of its capital allocation decisions. Therefore, this moat dimension concerning management integrity and capital allocation durability cannot be assessed.

profile.description: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited, established in 2011 and headquartered in Ningde, China, is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, production, and worldwide distribution of energy storage batteries and related systems. Its product range includes electric vehicle (EV) batteries, offered as individual cells, modules, or complete packs, and energy storage system (ESS) batteries, supplied as cells, racks, large containers, and full system integrations. CATL also manufactures crucial battery materials, such as lithium compounds, precursors, and cathode materials, alongside providing battery recycling and after-sales services. These advanced solutions are utilized across numerous sectors, powering passenger vehicles, public transportation, urban delivery fleets, heavy-duty transport, construction machinery, two-wheeled vehicles, and marine vessels. Furthermore, CATL's energy storage technologies support both utility-scale (front-of-the-meter) and commercial/residential (behind-the-meter) applications, as well as emerging fields like industrial machinery, aviation, and other specialized uses.

report.description_zh: 寧德時代新能源科技股份有限公司成立於二零一一年，總部位於中國寧德，是一家全球性企業，致力於儲能電池及相關系統的研發、生產和全球分銷。其產品範圍包括電動汽車電池，以單電池、模組或完整電池包形式提供；以及儲能系統電池，以單電池、電池架、大型集裝箱和完整系統整合形式供應。寧德時代還生產關鍵電池材料，如鋰化合物、前驅體和正極材料，並提供電池回收和售後服務。這些先進的解決方案應用於眾多領域，為乘用車、公共交通、城市配送車隊、重型運輸、工程機械、兩輪車和船舶提供動力。此外，寧德時代的儲能技術支援公用事業規模（電錶前）和商業/住宅（電錶後）應用，以及工業機械、航空和其他專業用途等新興領域。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 寧德時代在電池技術領域展現出顯著的規模和成本優勢，以及穩健的營運效率，這從其持續增長的盈利能力和現金流中可見一斑。其產品的整合性質也暗示了客戶可能面臨的轉換成本。然而，關於品牌定價能力、專利保護、戰略資產的不可複製性以及抵禦技術顛覆的具體證據則較為有限。本評估基於公開財務數據和公司描述進行的定性判斷，並非財務測量。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Limited (CATL) demonstrates significant scale and cost advantages in the battery technology sector, coupled with robust operational efficiency, evident from its consistent profitability and cash flow generation. The integrated nature of its products also suggests potential switching costs for customers. However, specific evidence regarding brand pricing power, patent protection, the irreproducibility of strategic assets, and resistance to technological disruption is limited. This assessment represents qualitative judgments based on publicly available financial data and company descriptions, and is not a financial measurement.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 公司描述雖顯示其為全球性企業，提供先進解決方案，但缺乏直接證據證明其品牌實力足以帶來顯著的定價權或溢價能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: While the company description indicates a global enterprise offering advanced solutions, direct evidence demonstrating its brand strength translates into significant pricing power or premium capabilities is absent.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司致力於研發，但公開資料中未具體提及任何專利或監管許可，足以構成顯著的競爭優勢或進入壁壘。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company is dedicated to research and development, but the available public information does not specifically mention any patents or regulatory licenses that confer a significant competitive advantage or create barriers to entry.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司提供電動汽車電池和儲能系統的完整整合方案，這些系統在關鍵應用中扮演核心角色。客戶若更換供應商，可能面臨顯著的重新設計、測試和認證成本，從而產生一定的轉換成本。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company provides fully integrated solutions for EV batteries and energy storage systems, which play a critical role in essential applications. Customers switching suppliers would likely incur significant re-engineering, testing, and certification costs, suggesting the presence of switching costs.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 公司業務模式主要為電池產品和系統的供應商，其價值不隨用戶數量的增加而提升，因此不具備網絡效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The company's business model primarily involves supplying battery products and systems, where the value does not inherently increase with the number of users, thus lacking network effects.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 作為一家全球性企業，從事電池及關鍵材料的研發、生產和全球分銷，其龐大的營運規模和垂直整合能力，很可能使其在採購、生產和研發方面享有顯著的成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: As a global enterprise involved in the research, production, and worldwide distribution of batteries and crucial materials, its vast operational scale and vertical integration likely provide significant cost advantages in procurement, manufacturing, and research and development.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 公司描述中未提及任何獨特的地理位置優勢或資產，能夠創造自然寡頭壟斷或高效規模經濟。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The company description does not mention any unique geographical advantages or assets that would create a natural oligopoly or efficient scale economies.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司在可觀察期間內持續產生穩健的淨收入、營運現金流和自由現金流，且毛利率和營運利潤率呈現改善趨勢，顯示其具備良好的營運效率和資本回報能力。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company consistently generated robust net income, operating cash flow, and free cash flow over the observable periods, with improving gross and operating margins, indicating strong operational efficiency and capital returns.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 雖然公司投資於研發和生產等戰略資產，但缺乏具體證據說明這些資產的不可複製性，例如獨特的技術或難以模仿的流程。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: While the company invests in strategic assets such as research and development and production, there is a lack of specific evidence detailing the irreproducibility of these assets, such as unique technologies or difficult-to-imitate processes.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司所處的電池行業技術發展迅速，市場需求變化快。儘管公司強調先進解決方案，但缺乏具體證據證明其客戶保留率高或能有效抵禦技術和需求變革帶來的顛覆。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: The battery industry, where the company operates, is characterized by rapid technological advancements and evolving market demands. Although the company emphasizes advanced solutions, specific evidence of high customer retention or effective resistance to technological and demand disruption is not provided.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司在最近的評估期內獲得了較高的皮洛斯基分數，這通常表明穩健的財務健康狀況。其資本配置策略顯示出對再投資和股東回報的平衡，反映了管理層的審慎決策。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company achieved a high Piotroski score in the most recent evaluation period, which generally indicates sound financial health. Its capital allocation strategy demonstrates a balance between reinvestment and shareholder returns, reflecting prudent management decisions.

profile.description: China Petroleum & Chemical Corporation, commonly referred to as Sinopec, is a prominent energy and chemical enterprise conducting operations across Mainland China, Singapore, and various international locations. Established in 2000, this Beijing-headquartered firm functions as a subsidiary of China Petrochemical Corporation. Sinopec's extensive business activities are structured into five core divisions: Exploration and Production, Refining, Marketing and Distribution, Chemicals, and Corporate and Others. Within its upstream segment, the company undertakes the exploration, development, and extraction of both crude oil and natural gas. For its downstream operations, Sinopec refines and purifies crude oil, subsequently manufacturing and marketing a comprehensive array of refined petroleum products. These products, which include gasoline and diesel fuels, are supplied to customers through the company's extensive network of oil depots, service stations, and via both wholesale and retail channels. In the chemical sector, Sinopec is a significant producer and distributor of petrochemicals and their derivatives. Its chemical product portfolio encompasses basic organic chemicals, synthetic resins, monomers and polymers used in synthetic fibers, synthetic rubber, and various chemical fertilizers. Beyond these primary areas, the corporation also participates in the international trade of petroleum products, natural gas, petrochemicals, and other chemical commodities. It is engaged in the development, production, and sale of specialized items such as catalyst products, lubricant base oils, polyester chips and fibers, plastics, and intermediate petrochemicals. Furthermore, Sinopec conducts research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of ethylene and its downstream byproducts. The company also provides a range of technical and operational services, including geophysical exploration, drilling, surveying, logging, downhole operations, and construction. It manages critical infrastructure services like crude oil jetty operations and natural gas pipeline transmission. Additionally, Sinopec manufactures equipment for production and engages in investment management activities within the coal chemical industry.
