Operator: Welcome and thank you very much for attending Sinopec'sThird Quarter Results Conference Call. Sinopec is hosting this conference callfrom Beijing and reporting the results are Mr. Dai Houliang, CFO, Mr. Chen Ge,Secretary of the Board of Directors, Mr. Liu Yun, Deputy CFO as well as the headsof certain operations. Before we begin this presentation I would like to remindeverybody of Sinopec's Safe Harbor policy, namely that certain statements madeduring the course of our discussion today may constitute forward-lookingstatements that are based on the management's current expectations and beliefs,which are subject to a number of risks and uncertainties that could causeactual results to differ materially, including risks that may be beyond theCompany's control. Any forward-looking statements made are valid as of todayand Sinopec takes no obligation to update these statements. I would now like to turn the conference over to Mr. Dai. Mr.Dai, you may begin.
Dai Houliang: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning, welcome to Sinopec's thirdquarter 2007 results announcement conference call. We have listed our results,our slides and the webcast. Please refer to these results and the webcast. To save more time I would like to ask Mr. Wang Jiming, theInterpreter of Sinopec, to deliver the third quarter 2007 results in English.Mr. Wang, now please go ahead.
Wang Jiming: Good morning ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Sinopec'sthird quarter 2007 results conference call. During the first three quarters of2007 China's economy maintained rapid growth with GDP up by 11.5% and demandfor petroleum and petrochemical products increased at a good momentum. In Q3 '07, despite the pressure from surging internationalcrude price on our production operation, the Company's strategic production managementand synergized production and marketing, certainly pushed forward keyconstruction projects, focused strong result conservation and emissionreduction, ensured safe production and market supply and achieved very goodoperating results. According to the International Accounting Standard, duringthe first three quarters our revenue totaled CNY875.218 billion, up 13.62% yearon year. EBIT amounted to CNY74.065 billion, up 38.28% year on year. Profit attributed to shareholders reached CNY49.818 billion.EPS was CNY0.575, up 43.21% year on year. As of September 30, 2007 ourshort-term and long-term debt totaled CNY109.725 billion, down CNY4.716 billionthan that of the year beginning. Equity attributed to shareholders were CNY298.907 billion,up 13.72% than the year beginning. During the first three quarters of 2007 cashflows from the operating activities of CNY98.486 billion. Cash flow used in investing activities was CNY69.158billion. Cash and cash equivalent ending balance was CNY8.343 billion, up byCNY1.664 billion than the year beginning. For the Upstream during the past three quarters with astrong crude price, we expedited capacity using and developed low used reservesto steadily build up oil and gas output. Construction of the national key project, the Sichuan toEast China Gas Transmission project was kicked off smoothly. We produced 30.69million tons of crude oil and 5.976 BCM of natural gas, up by 2.23% and 11.74%year on year respectively. For the first three quarters crude realized price averagedCNY2955.57 per ton, down by 12.76% year on year. Gas realized price averagedCNY809.94 per thousand cubic meters, up 7.89% year on year. Lifting cost wasCNY557.91 per ton, up by 18.62% year on year. EBIT was CNY37.265 billion, downby 29.15% year on year. In the Refining segment the Company made efforts to re-adaptstructure and optimize the resource allocation, procurement and constructing toincrease production and ensure market supply. Crude processed was CNY115.8 million tons, up 6.53% year onyear. Refined product output was CNY68.83 million tons, up by 6.33%. Impactedby the tight control of the refined product price, refining margin in the firstthree quarters was CNY194 per ton. EBIT was CNY214 million. In marketing segments, the Company actively sourcedhydrocarbon resources and brought to ensure stable and orderly supply todomestic market. Really focused on our modern logistic system including productpipeline to well-organized distribution and transportation of oil products, theMarketing was further optimized. For the first three quarters total sales volume and Retailvolume reached 88.57 million tons and 55.82 million tons, up by 6.63% and 4.55%respectively. By end of September Retail side totaled 28,980 in which 28,280were self performed and operated. Annualized throughput per self-operated station averaged2,632 tons, up by 2.57%. In the first three quarters EBIT of the Marketingsegment was CNY26.026 billion, up by 26.49%. In Chemical segment safe and stable operation and highutilization were achieved with increased output on major products and highvalue added products. The Company leveraged on the specialized offering ofchemical products sales company to further sharpen other competitive edge tominimize market in China. For the first three quarters output of ethylene andsynthetic resins were 4.887 million tons and 7.207 million tons, up by 7.79%and 14.6% respectively. In the first three quarters EBIT of the Chemicalsegment was CNY11.097 billion, up by 8.32%. CapEx in the first three quarters totaled CNY59.91 billion,in which E&P was CNY30.807 billion. Refining was CNY12.178 billion.Chemical was CNY7.207 billion. Marketing and Distribution was CNY7.948 billion.Corporate and Others was CNY1.77 billion. That's all for the briefings on the first three quartersresults. Now, Mr. Dai Houliang and his colleagues would be happy to take yourquestions. Thank you very much.
Chen Ge: Operator, please can we have the first question?
Operator: (Operator Instructions) The first question is from PrashantGokhale from Credit Suisse. Please go ahead.
Prashant Gokhale: Good morning sir, thank you for the presentation, just aquick question. There have been press reports recently about diesel shortagesin China. Could you tell us if these diesel shortages are because ofproduction constraints or because demand is exceptionally strong? Thank you.
Dai Houliang: Overall speaking, the supply of the diesel in China isstable. There may be some particular situation in certain specific regions as aresult of a number of factors. First of all, the demand for diesel is growing and becauseof the impact of natural gas the transportation, in the transportation channelthere have been some force major factors happening. But, overall speaking, we believe the supply of diesel inChina is stable and steady. Thank you.
Prashant Gokhale: Yes. Then could I just ask an additional question? When yousay that because of natural gas, what do you exactly mean by that? How is that,how does that impact diesel demand, if you could just explain?
Dai Houliang: To be specific, impacted by the hurricane in the pastperiod, there are some impacts, negative impacts inflicted our specific retailstations. And so, we have some, encountered some force major factors in thosespecific retail stations because of the hurricane and some weather conditions.
Prashant Gokhale: Thank you sir. Thank you very much.
Operator: Thank you. The next question is from Upin Lau (ph) of INET.Please go ahead.
Upin Lau: My question is currently given the high cost and the lowretail price there are some retail stations who are reluctant to sell thediesel. What kind of impact does this have to your refining segment?
Dai Houliang: Because of the international oil price hike in 3Q and thetight control by the state government for the oil product price in China, thereare some retail stations in China, who now stop to sell certain gas productsbecause of those reasons. And this inflicted certain impact of pressure on Sinopec'ssupply to the market. There are some impacts on our Refining segment, whichcould be fully demonstrated by the figures from our 4Q to 3Q results and inEBIT figures. But for the Chemical segment, as you asked, there are no bigimpacts on our Chemical segments.
Upin Lau: Were there any negative impacts on your high-end segment? Doyou have a certain solution?
Dai Houliang: On the technical side, we will try to lower our purchasecost and in the meantime to minimizing the pressure on our Refining segment. Onthe market side we will try our utmost to fulfill our social responsibility asa big company to supply the market.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) The next question is from FlorenceTan (ph) of ICIS. Please go ahead. Please go ahead Miss Tan.
Florence Tan: Hello?
Dai Houliang: Hello.
Florence Tan: Hi. Can you hear me?
Dai Houliang: Yes.
Florence Tan: I have three questions from ICIS. What will be the timeschedule for the production time for Xinhau Refinery project? Second question, given the current higher international oilprice, what impact it will have on your 4Q EBIT and earning growth? And third question, with regard to the Guangdong Refineryand Chemical project will Shell quite or not?
Dai Houliang: Let me first address your first question. With regard to theXinhau Refinery project everything is now on track according to our schedule.By the end of this year and the 4Q 2008 some key equipment will be constructedand completed. And, we expect to have the commissioning of the project by the 2Qnext year. And with regard to the impact of the high international oilprice on our Refining segment, I believe everyone in the public could give somecertain analysis. With regard to the Guangzhou Nansha project, currently it isstill in a preliminary period and the front-end negotiation discussion. So far,we are not aware of any information that Shell is intending to quit.
Florence Tan: Thank you.
Operator: Thank you. The next question is from Lawrence Lo of BOCI.Please go ahead.
Lawrence Lo: I'm from BOCI. I have three questions. Firstly that withregard to the Refining segment for the first three few quarters what is the mixor proportion of the processing amount of your low grade crude as a total amongyour total throughput? A second question is on the cash operating cost for yourthird quarter. How much it changed as against of last year? And third question, given the last year's performance therewas a quite big loss from the first quarter to third quarter. Will you begranted subsidies this year as you were in the last year?
Dai Houliang: With regard to your first question, currently the crudethroughput proportion for the height of high acid and the low-grade crudeamount for 60% of our total crude throughput. But for the really low quality orlow grade crude the proportion is simply 20% of the total. So, from the first quarter to the third quarter the figuresof our crude processing could be list as follows. For the 1Q 56, 2Q -- sorry,$56 per barrel as the price assumption, and 2Q $62, 3Q $68. On the one hand we have tried to minimize our purchase cost.On the other, we try to increase the volume of the crude processing for the lowgrade crude, which fully sharpen our competitiveness in refining segment. Besides, about one-third of our products are fully in linewith the market price internationally. For example, the Napa, its price is nowfully in line with the in Singapore market price, which also keeping up ourcompetitiveness in the Refining segment. With regard to the Government subsidy, I cannot give you aspecific answer, because it is the business of the Government.
Lawrence Lo: Thank you.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) The next question is from Calvin Coof Coleman. Please go ahead.
Calvin Co: Could you please shed some light on the gas transmissionproject from Sichuan to Guangzhou in terms of it’s volume, the CapEx and timeto go?
Dai Houliang: Are you asking the project from the Sichuan to East China?The gentlemen found the company?
Calvin Co: I'm enquiring about currently do you have any intention tofirst study the gas project from Sichuan to Guangdong?
Dai Houliang: After we discovered Puguang gas field, we also located somegood process reserves in the other regions of Sichuan Province. Currently theCompany is still planning for the front-end study. I believe this is quite muchunder the public attention. We would thank you for the attention. And if we locatesome specific reserves for the accurate information we will try to disclose ona timely basis.
Calvin Co: Thank you.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) Next question is from PrashantGokhale from Credit Suisse. Please go ahead.
Prashant Gokhale: Two questions on the Sichuan gas, could you tell us how muchof the Sichuan gas, the Puguang gas are you planning to sell in Sichuan? And isthere any specific plan to sell a part of that gas in Sichuan? And the second question is how much gas do you expect to usein your own refineries and your own petrochemical plants to substitute forrefinery fuel and chemical plant fuel?
Dai Houliang: With regard to your first question, a large amount of thenatural gas from the Puguang will be mainly supplied to the East of China wherethere are quite the large demands for natural gas. But there are some portionsof gas that will be reserved for Sichuan province to develop its own chemicalindustry and supply the local market. For Sinopec, we will reserve about 1billion cubic meters natural gas from Puguang to substitute our fuels andchemicals feed stock. Thank you.
Prashant Gokhale: Thank you. I also had one other question if I may.
Dai Houliang: Okay, please.
Prashant Gokhale: Okay. There's a lot of talk about Sinopec buying theoverseas assets from the parent. Could you give us a comment? And I understandthat if you're doing it you can't tell me. But would you at least give us thethinking behind -- what management is thinking in terms of the overseas assetsand what your maybe your priorities are and what your timeline is on this?
Dai Houliang: With regard to the purchase of overseas assets of the parentcompany, Sinopec Corp has the first right of refusal to purchase the overseasassets of the parent. But currently, we have no concrete plan or proposal onthat.
Prashant Gokhale: Thank you. Thank you very much.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) Next question is from Henik Fung ofHSBC. Please go ahead.
Henik Fung: Compared with the upstream business, the crude realization,in 3Q 2006 and 3Q 2007 there is no big differential. But for the EBIT of the 3Q2007 E&P business, we witnessed that there was quite a noticeable drop inthe EBIT by 16% to 17%. Is there any reason behind this?
Dai Houliang: The reason is mainly because of the price adjustment thatSinopec's crude is relative. As we disclosed in our annual report in 2006, wehave readjusted our crude grade that Sinopec is relative to crude ever sincethe August last year. Sinopec's Shaanxi oilfield used to be relative to theSimta (ph) oil price. But, ever since the August last year, the Sinopec sellcrude is relative to the Dooley. So, mainly because of the changes arising fromthe pricing correlation mechanism.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) The next question is from FlorenceTan of ICIS. Please go ahead.
Florence Tan: I have two questions. The first question is that is theCompany still following or following up the MTO project in Dazhou of SichuanProvince? Second is your specific -- do you have specific proposals orplans to develop biodiesel?
Dai Houliang: With regard to the MTO project you mentioned about,currently Sinopec is still doing a preliminary period work for this project.And the MTO R&D capability is now -- of Sinopec is now under the pilotplanned period. So now we are studying the feasibility of the MTO project. With regard to the biodiesel development, Sinopec is nowdeveloping certain pilot plant scale projects in its affiliates on biodiesel.These facilities now demonstrate quite good performance, and for the stepforward we would like to identify the economic viability and feasibility forthese kind of fuels to replace the conventional fuels.
Florence Tan: I would like to add one more question about MTO project inDazhou. Currently, Chinese government does not allow the natural gas to beutilized in heavy chemical projects. Will this policy have any impact on yourproject in Dazhou?
Dai Houliang: On broad base there is no such category that Chinesegovernment limited or encourage the natural gas based chemical projects. Theydo have certain encouraging laws; some certain laws to encourage natural gasbased chemical projects. And they do have certain laws that does not encouragethe natural gas chemical projects.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) There are no further questions. Wehave a question from Yung Wei of Wothai Chun Ann (ph) Securities. Please goahead.
Yung Wei: I'd like to ask a question about special oil income levy.For the first half how much is the special income levy and what will be thefigure for the 3Q?
Dai Houliang: In terms of the special oil levy income CNY7.1 billion from theJanuary to September.
Yung Wei: And currently the international oil price went up to ahistorical high. What do you think of the future price trajectory for theinternational oil?
Dai Houliang: I'd like to first address your last question. The specialoil income levy was CNY3.5 billion in the third quarter. And With regard to thequestion on international oil price, this is a hot topic under globalattention. So, to be honest that in September we have worked togetherwith about 30 agencies to analyze the international oil price trend. The resultas the average weighted price was about US$70 in September. But just a month past,now we witnessed today it is already close to US$95 a barrel. So from the supply/demand side we think that current oilprice hike is supposed to be too much inflated should be dropped to its normallevel. But the current price is justified by certain other reasons such as thepolitical, the financial and the regional factors. It's really hard for us totell the fortune what will happen tomorrow. Thank you.
Operator: (Operator Instructions) Thank you. There are no furtherquestions at this time.
Chen Ge: Operator, thank you very much. We are now going to closethis teleconference. To access the replay of the conference call, please call852-3006-8101. The access code will be 558553. You can also listen to thewebcast replay on the company's website at www.sinopec.com, starting at 9.00 amon October 31 Hong Kong time. Thank you again for your interest in Sinopec. Please feelfree to contact either Sinopec directly or (inaudible) if you have additionalquestions. Good day or good night depending on where you are, everyone.
Dai Houliang: Thank you for your attention. On behalf of Sinopec, I'd liketo thank you all for expressions of support and concern for Sinopec.

report.description_zh: 中國石油化工股份有限公司，通常簡稱為中國石化，是一家卓越的能源和化工企業，業務遍及中國大陸、新加坡及多個國際地區。該公司成立於二零零零年，總部設於北京，是中國石油化工集團公司的子公司。中國石化的廣泛業務活動分為五個核心部門：勘探與生產、煉油、營銷與分銷、化工以及企業及其他。在其上游業務中，公司從事原油和天然氣的勘探、開發和開採。在下游業務方面，中國石化提煉和淨化原油，隨後生產和銷售一系列全面的精煉石油產品。這些產品包括汽油和柴油，通過公司廣泛的油庫、服務站網絡以及批發和零售渠道供應給客戶。在化工領域，中國石化是石化產品及其衍生物的重要生產商和分銷商。其化工產品組合涵蓋基礎有機化學品、合成樹脂、用於合成纖維的單體和聚合物、合成橡膠以及各種化肥。除了這些主要領域，公司還參與石油產品、天然氣、石化產品及其他化工商品的國際貿易。它從事催化劑產品、潤滑油基礎油、聚酯切片和纖維、塑料以及中間石化產品等專業產品的開發、生產和銷售。此外，中國石化還進行乙烯及其下游副產品的研發、製造和商業化。公司還提供一系列技術和運營服務，包括地球物理勘探、鑽井、測量、測井、井下作業和建設。它管理關鍵基礎設施服務，如原油碼頭運營和天然氣管道輸送。此外，中國石化還製造生產設備，並從事煤化工行業的投資管理活動。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 中國石化作為一家大型綜合能源和化工企業，受益於其龐大的規模、廣泛的資產基礎以及在中國能源領域的戰略地位。其強大的分銷網絡和國家重點項目參與提供了顯著的競爭優勢。然而，其產品的商品性質以及政府對價格的嚴格控制限制了其定價能力和部分業務的盈利潛力。此外，能源行業面臨長期技術和需求變革的挑戰，儘管公司已開始探索多元化發展。本次評估基於有限的公開資料，特別是較早期的電話會議記錄，且未包含所有維度的充分證據，因此分數為人工智慧的定性判斷，而非財務測量。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Sinopec, as a large integrated energy and chemical enterprise, benefits from its immense scale, extensive asset base, and strategic position within China's energy sector. Its robust distribution network and involvement in national key projects provide significant competitive advantages. However, the commodity nature of its products and strict government price controls limit its pricing power and profitability in certain segments. Furthermore, the energy industry faces long-term technological and demand shifts, although the company is exploring diversification. This assessment is based on limited public data, particularly an older earnings call transcript, and does not contain sufficient evidence for all dimensions, thus the scores represent AI qualitative judgment rather than financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 公司作為一家卓越的能源和化工企業，擁有廣泛的油庫和服務站網絡，這表明其在市場上具有強大的品牌知名度和分銷能力。然而，政府對精煉產品價格的嚴格控制限制了其定價權，並影響了煉油業務的盈利能力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: As a prominent energy and chemical enterprise with an extensive network of oil depots and service stations, the company demonstrates strong brand recognition and distribution capabilities in the market. However, strict government control over refined product prices limits its pricing power and impacts the profitability of its refining segment.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司在高度管制的能源行業中運營，並作為中國石油化工集團公司的子公司，享有國家支持和戰略地位。其參與國家重點項目，如四川至華東天然氣輸氣工程，進一步鞏固了其監管優勢和市場地位。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: Operating within a highly regulated energy sector and as a subsidiary of China Petrochemical Corporation, the company benefits from state backing and a strategic position. Its involvement in national key projects, such as the Sichuan to East China Gas Transmission project, further solidifies its regulatory advantages and market standing.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司主要提供汽油、柴油和石化產品等大宗商品，這些產品的客戶轉換成本通常較低。儘管其分銷網絡廣泛，但這主要提供便利性而非顯著的轉換壁壘。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company primarily offers commodity products such as gasoline, diesel, and petrochemicals, for which customer switching costs are generally low. While its distribution network is extensive, this primarily offers convenience rather than creating significant barriers to switching.

profile.description: Weichai Power Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of diesel engines, vehicles, and a wide array of automotive components. The company organizes its extensive operations across three key segments: Engines, Automobiles and Automobile Components, and Intelligent Logistics. Its comprehensive business scope covers the full lifecycle — from design and development to manufacturing, sales, repair, and international trade — for a variety of products. These include engines and their auxiliary systems, automobile axles and components, gearboxes, hydraulic pumps, motors, and valves, as well as gears, gear transmission devices, and casting products for hydraulic components. Beyond these, Weichai Power also provides internal combustion engines, energy powertrain systems, and related ancillary items. Complementing its manufacturing, the company extends its services to technical consultation, technical support, property leasing, and business management. It also supplies steel, forklift trucks, and advanced warehousing technology and supply chain solutions. The company's prominent brands include Weichai Power Engine, Fast Gear, Hande Axle, Shacman Heavy Truck, and Linder Hydraulics. Founded in 2002, Weichai Power Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Weifang, People's Republic of China.

profile.description: CMOC Group Limited, through its diverse subsidiaries, is a multifaceted enterprise engaged in the entire value chain from the extraction, processing, and refining to the commercialization of numerous metallic resources. These include essential minerals like copper, cobalt, molybdenum, tungsten, niobium, and phosphates, alongside other base and rare metals. The company's extensive product offerings encompass molybdenum oxide, ferromolybdenum, concentrates of molybdenum, tungsten, and copper, cobalt hydroxide, ferroniobium, phosphate fertilizer, and precious metals such as gold and silver. Beyond its core mining activities, CMOC also undertakes the processing and distribution of mineral products, trades in molybdenum and tungsten commodities, and participates in the international import and export of both goods and technology. Its operational scope further extends into service sectors, covering hotel management, consulting, corporate operations, asset management, logistics, and transportation services. CMOC maintains a substantial global footprint, with active operations across China, Australia, Brazil, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Switzerland, and various other international locations. The company was initially established in 2006 under the name China Molybdenum Co., Ltd., and its corporate headquarters are situated in Luoyang, People's Republic of China.

transcripts.content:
Hui Xu: Dear investors and friends who care about CMOC Group Limited, good afternoon. I am Hui Xu, Board Secretary of CMOC Group. I would like to welcome all investors, analysts and media friends to CMOC Group Limited’s Online Performance Meeting of 1st Half of 2025. This performance meeting will be broadcast live to global investors through SSE Roadshow Center. On behalf of CMOC Group, I would like to take this opportunity to thank all of you for your long-standing trust and support. The management of the Company attending the meeting today are Mr. Jianfeng Liu, Chairman and Chief Investment Officer; Mr. Chaoyang Que, Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer; Mr. Xingyao Chen, Vice President and CFO; and Ms. Hongyu Gu, Independent Director, attending the meeting online. This performance meeting will be divided into two parts. For the first part, we will deliver the production, operation and financial situation of CMOC Group in the first half of 2025, and for the second part, we will have an interactive exchange with investors on site as well as online. I will now report on the financial results in the first half of 2025. CMOC Group started as a traditional state-owned county enterprise in Henan Province, China, and was established in 1969. It has gone through three corporate restructurings, four equity financings, and six major overseas asset acquisitions, with a cumulative M&A investment of more than USD10 billion, and ranks among the front-runners in the international mining industry. In June this year, the Company successfully completed the acquisition of the Ecuadorian gold mine, which is the Company's first mine with gold as the main product. In terms of overall resources and reserves, the size of resources and reserves is the central indicator of the value of a mining company. As of the end of 2024, the Company has 34.405 million metric tons of copper resources and 5.4 million metric tons of cobalt resources, with nearly 50 years of mining ahead at current production capacity levels. Molybdenum resources are 800,000 metric tons, tungsten resources are 106,000 metric tons, niobium resources are 2,048,000 metric tons, and phosphorus resources are 80.05 million metric tons. The Company's existing mines have the potential to increase the size of resources for each metal in the future through deep exploration work. From the perspective of shareholder governance structure, CFC and CATL, as the Company's two major shareholders, can provide more guidance and support to the Company in terms of strategic M&A as well as the future trend of the non-ferrous metal industry's application in the field of new energy. A good corporate governance structure can lead a company to go farther and develop more solidly. I will focus on reporting the overall performance of the Company in the first half of 2025. In the first half of 2025, the Company upgraded its organization, reduced costs and increased efficiency, and further improved its operational efficiency, achieving operating revenue of CNY94.8 billion, a slight YoY decrease. Operating income was divided into mining and trading business; the operating income of mining segment achieved YoY increase of 25.64%, while the trading business showed YoY decline. In the trading business, the Company restructured product lines with low profitability levels. Although revenues from the trading business declined, the contribution of trading profit reached its best level ever. EBITDA achieved CNY19.8 billion, YoY increase of 23.8%, thanks to higher commodity prices and improved sales volumes. Net attributable profit hit another record high for the same period, realizing CNY8.7 billion, YoY increase of 60%. Operating cash flow continued to be robust, realizing CNY12 billion, YoY increase of 11.4%. Gearing ratio decreased to 50.15%. The return on net assets showed YoY improvement of almost three percentage points to 11.7%. In the first half of 2025, the copper and cobalt segment contributed 84% of the gross profit in the mining segment, while molybdenum- tungsten and niobium-phosphorus contributed 9% and 7%, respectively. The gross profit margin of the mining segment was reached 52%, YoY improvement of nearly 6 percentage points, which was mainly attributable to the increase in product prices as well as effective cost control. In terms of the copper business in the African zone by region and by product, the Company's copper production reached 354,000 metric tons in the first half of 2025, YoY improvement of 12.7%. Both TFM and KFM production achieved half time and more than half task. The operational efficiency of TFM's Central Region has improved, and the capacity of the Eastern Region is continuing to be released. KFM has maintained a high processing capacity and the entry grade is maintained at a relatively good level. The Company achieved copper sales of 323,000 metric tons, YoY improvement of 3.5%. The Company's gross profit margin for copper products was 53.6% in the first half of the year, an improvement of 1.3 percentage points. In terms of new project advancement, TFM has completed the geological modeling of [Inaudible] and other exploration ore bodies, and is adjusting the overall planning based on the latest data. KFM's Phase II project is also under active preparation. For the cobalt business in the African zone, the Company achieved 61,000 metric tons of cobalt production in the first half of 2025, YoY increase of 13.1%, mainly due to further improvements in beneficiation recoveries. The Company's cobalt sales achieved 46,000 metric tons, YoY decline of 9.3%, mainly due to the impact of the cobalt export ban. Cobalt products achieved a gross profit margin of 61.8%, YoY improvement of 19.7 percentage points, which was mainly based on the improvement in cobalt prices. Looking at our business in China, our molybdenum and tungsten business in China has become a new profit growth point through refined process improvement, continuous strengthening of cost control and better results in the sulfur recovery program. In the first half of 2025, the Company's molybdenum production accomplished 52% of the median annual production guidance. Overcoming the negative impact of declining grades, molybdenum concentrator recovery achieved a 3.6 percentage point improvement. The Company's molybdenum sales finished at 7,239 metric tons, a slight YoY improvement. Gross margin for molybdenum products was 38.3%, YoY increase of 4.5 percentage points. Take another look at our tungsten business in China. The Company's tungsten production in the first half of 2025 was 59% of the median annual production guidance, with a 3.7 percentage point improvement in recovery achieved through optimized pharmaceutical studies and process management. The Company's tungsten sales volume achieved 4,277 metric tons, YoY improvement of 7%. Gross profit margin for tungsten products achieved 64.3%, YoY improvement of 3.2 percentage point. In terms of the niobium business in Brazil, the production volume of niobium plates exceeded the budget in terms of both recovery rate and sales volume, and the goal of completing more than half of the tasks within half the time was also fully achieved. In particular, both of our BVF2 and BV picks achieved the best recovery rates in years. In the first half of 2025, the Company's niobium production accomplished 52% of the median annual production guidance, a slight YoY improvement. Sales of niobium finished at 5,462 metric tons, YoY improvement of 5.5%. Product gross margin of 46.1% showed YoY improvement of 10.3 percentage points. In the first half of 2025, the average price of ferro-niobium was approximately USD46 per kilogram, with the Asian market being the most significant source of demand, particularly China and India. The market continued to expand, with growing demand for specialty steels containing niobium in the automotive sector. Emerging sector applications were also penetrating fast, and the relative weakness in the construction steel sector supported overall niobium consumption to remain resilient. In terms of Brazil's phosphorus business, in the first half of 2025, the Company's phosphorus production was 583,000 metric tons, unchanged from the same period last year, and already 51% of the midpoint of this year's full-year production guidance. The Company's phosphorus sales finished at 589,000 metric tons, YoY improvement of 9.3%. Gross margin for phosphorus products was 31.1%, YoY improvement of 13 percentage points. The average price of monoammonium phosphate in Brazil was USD677.6 per metric ton, YoY increase of 18%. Affected by the expected price increase, the overall market realized an early procurement, January to April this year, demand had an 11% increase, this trend has been continued in the first half of the year. Below, I will introduce the situation of gold mines in Ecuador. The Ecuador Gold Project was completed by the Company on June 23, 2025, with a consideration of CAD581 million, equivalent to approximately CNY3 billion. This is the Company's second greenfield project after KFM, and the Company has strong project management experience in greenfield project development. The project is now undergoing the necessary additional site work, completing the update and transformation of the feasibility study and fully optimizing the scheme based on the latest data, and the related work such as licensing and permitting is being carried forward in an orderly manner. All preparations for the pre-construction period have been initiated. The project aims to be in production by 2029, and details of the production scale, costs, capital expenditure and other planning will be updated for investors as the latest feasibility study is completed. In the first half of 2025, Exxon (IXM) saw a steady increase in volume, with an overall physical trade volume of 2.15 million metric tons. Under IAS, the gross margin was achieved at 2.35%, also a record high. Exxon focused on high-margin, advantaged product lines, restructured poorly profitable products, and capitalized on the trading window during the tariff period to achieve an uplift in spot margins in the first half of the year. As a trading company, strict risk control is the core task, and we can see that good results have been achieved by strengthening the control in the execution process for some risks related to liquidity risk, market risk, counterparty risk, credit risk and HSE risk. Overall Exxon's efficiency in the use of funds was further improved and liquidity was maintained at a favorable level. You can see how a trading company based in a mining company can both sell our products at a relatively good price and effectively control risk and realize sustainable profitability. Here's a look at the ESG performance, the Company has always demonstrated excellence in ESG management, and the MSCI rating has remained AA for three consecutive years, at the forefront of global non-ferrous metal mining companies. In addition, it was honored on the Fortune China 2025 China ESG Impact List. Our trading company also maintained a gold medal in the Ecovadis Sustainability Rating, ranking in the top 3% of all industries globally. It's safe to say that what's behind these ratings and awards is what we've done to be recognized by the parties involved. Here are two examples. The first is in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the Company has been active in community development, building 30 new educational institutions and offering a scholarship program for teacher-training students. This year, we launched the 100- member International Mining Talent Training Program in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In order to deepen China-Africa economic and trade cooperation and share the development results, the Company has joined hands with Central South University to promote joint schooling through the tripartite synergy mechanism of school, government and enterprise. In the future, we plan to train 100 internationalized talents who are proficient in mining knowledge and skills, Chinese language ability and cross-cultural communication ability in five years. The aims are to promote international exchange and cooperation, improve the quality of higher education, and enhance the international perspective and competitiveness of students. We also provide agricultural support programs to 30,000 farmers. Establishment of water and electricity networks to provide clean drinking water for 400,000 people and bring electricity for domestic use to 200,000 people. Ten hospitals have been built, more than 60,000 children have been vaccinated, and the incidence of malaria among schoolchildren has been reduced by more than 50 per cent. The Company released its Carbon Neutral roadmap in 2023, committing Peak Carbon by 2030 and Carbon Neutral by 2050, and plans to invest no less than USD1.5 billion by 2050 in achieving emissions reductions through energy efficiency, electrification, renewable energy, and carbon replenishment. At present, each of our mines has formulated the 2030 Peak Carbon implementation plan, and is pushing forward the implementation of the emission reduction program according to the timetable. In China, for example, in terms of photovoltaic power generation, the cumulative power generation capacity of photovoltaic in China since the second half of 2022 has been about 26.2 million kWh, with a cumulative saving of CNY16.9 million in electricity costs and a cumulative reduction of 14,020 metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions. The 36-megawatt source-grid-load-storage project currently under construction can integrate and optimize our clean power sources, grids, loads, and energy storage to achieve coordinated interaction and improve energy utilization efficiency and system stability. In terms of electric mining card usage, electric mining cards now total 151 units, or about 87%. Electricity consumption is 72% less expensive than fuel consumption, saving CNY29.69 million per year and reducing CO2 emissions by 10,688 metric tons per year. Calculated from 2021, the cumulative cost savings to date exceeds CNY100 million. In the face of the added demand for metals brought about by the energy and technological revolutions, and in the face of the challenge of environmental protection, the Company acts as the upstream of the carbon footprint, delivering the cleanest products to the downstream, so that the final consumer can use the greenest products. As a responsible mining company, making the world a better place is the goal the Company pursues. The above is a report on the business side of the Company, and the following is a report on the financial data. In order to achieve the goal of the 2025 Year of Change, the Company focused on organizational change, sustained efficiency management, and carried out technological innovation by extensively promoting the transformation of production processes, while seizing the market opportunity of rising commodity prices. Firstly, let's look at the overall revenue. Operating revenue for the first half of the year amounted to CNY94.773 billion, showed YoY decrease. The main reason for the decline in revenue, in fact, as I mentioned earlier, was mainly a decrease in revenue from our trading business. In terms of trading business, the Company restructured product lines with low profitability levels, resulting in YoY decline of 11.44% in revenue. However, our mining segment operating income achieved YoY increase of 25.64%. Operating costs fell even more sharply than operating revenues. We have achieved better results in the control of operating costs; YoY decrease of 11%. Decreases were realized in both administrative and financial expenses, especially in financial expenses, which decreased by 44%. The significant decrease in overall finance costs was realized mainly due to the repayment of long-term borrowings and the replacement of some low-interest borrowings for low-interest products. In the first half of 2025, EBITDA increased significantly to CNY19.8 billion, a growth rate of nearly 24%, due to the growth in product sales and our overall commodity prices. Net attributable profit reached CNY8.67 billion, achieving a strong YoY growth of up to 60%. Earnings per share was CNY0.41. As a result of the further improvement in profitability, the Company's overall balance sheet profile in the first half of the year maintained a more robust structure. First, take a look at the asset side, our total asset size has remained stable and our money funds were relatively abundant. As you can see, the money fund balance has exceeded the sum of our short-term and long-term borrowings. On the debt side, short-term borrowings were CNY20.3 billion, up from the end of 2024, with this major increment coming from the increase in our trading business. In terms of long-term borrowings, it was CNY3.9 billion, a decrease of 58% compared to the end of 2024. This was mainly due to the early return of long-term borrowings after the normal commissioning of our mine operations, which greatly reduced the Company's interest burden. Normalized net assets were CNY73.8 billion and gearing ratio was 50.15%, maintaining a good level and a more robust overall corporate financial structure. In terms of cash flow, the Company's core business continued to strengthen its blood-forming ability, and its free cash flow grew rapidly, with net cash inflow from operating activities reaching CNY12 billion, YoY increase of more than 11%. The main reason was the YoY increase in net cash flow from operations due to the favorable operating conditions of the mining business. Net cash outflow from investing activities amounted to CNY2.3 billion, the decrease in outflow was mainly due to the successive commissioning of the expansion projects in the previous period and the capital expenditure ending. Net cash outflow from financing activities amounted to CNY7.9 billion, the increase in outflow was mainly due to the YoY decrease in cash inflow from the Company's acquisition of borrowings and the YoY increase in cash outflow from our external dividend distribution. Capital expenditures for the first half of the year were CNY4.1 billion, which was mainly due to the Company's completion of the acquisition of the Cangrejos Gold Mine in June for a consideration of close to CNY3 billion, which was also included in the capital expenditures for Q2. Free cash flow increased significantly to CNY7,866 million, with a growth rate of 15.4%, which is a record high in recent years. It can be seen that the Company has achieved profitable revenue and cash flow profits. At the beginning of 2025, the Company set its production targets for the whole year, and the results for the first half of the year were very satisfactory. In the second half of 2025, although there are many uncertainties and huge challenges in terms of the macroeconomy, geopolitics, and commodity market trends, the Company is confident that it will achieve the targets set at the beginning of the year with the same high quality as always.

Jianfeng Liu: First, I would like to thank all analysts and investors for their support of the Company. The share price hit a new high today, which is a pressure and an incentive for the Company's management. Given the significant growth in the Company's performance in the first half of the year, we will continue to focus on three things in the second half of the year and beyond. Firstly, which is of great concern to all of you, is how to further develop our existing mine resources, further expand production, and realize the value, including the DRC, Ecuador, and the existing stock of assets in the mines in the China zone. Secondly, you are concerned about whether we can effectively access resources in today's more competitive non-ferrous metals and minerals industry to provide a greater resource base for the Company's longer-term growth. Thirdly, our management upgrade has just begun. Finally, our aim is to realize the creation of a platform-type enterprise, and to realize the development of CMOC Group from pure mine operation to a platform-type enterprise based on mine operation as a whole, including long-term resource development. Finally, we hope that investors will support us. Our management is confident in creating long-term value for you, our investors and shareholders.
Hui Xu: Today's performance meeting ends. Thank you to all investors for your continued interest in CMOC Group. If you have any questions in the future, please feel free to contact our AR team. [END]

report.description_zh: 洛陽欒川鉬業集團股份有限公司透過其多元化的子公司，是一家從多種金屬資源的開採、加工、精煉到商業化，涵蓋整個價值鏈的綜合性企業。這些資源包括銅、鈷、鉬、鎢、鈮和磷酸鹽等基本和稀有金屬。該公司廣泛的產品包括氧化鉬、鐵鉬、鉬精礦、鎢精礦、銅精礦、氫氧化鈷、鈮鐵、磷肥以及黃金和白銀等貴金屬。除了核心採礦業務外，洛陽欒川鉬業還從事礦產品的加工和分銷，鉬和鎢商品的貿易，並參與商品和技術的國際進出口。其業務範圍進一步擴展到服務領域，涵蓋酒店管理、諮詢、企業運營、資產管理、物流和運輸服務。洛陽欒川鉬業在全球擁有廣泛的業務足跡，在中國、澳洲、巴西、剛果民主共和國、瑞士以及其他多個國際地點積極運營。該公司最初於二零零六年以中國鉬業有限公司的名義成立，其企業總部設在中華人民共和國洛陽。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 洛陽欒川鉬業集團股份有限公司在多個經濟護城河維度上展現出實力，尤其是在規模和成本優勢、獨特的地理資產以及營運效率方面。作為全球主要的銅和鈷生產商，公司受益於其龐大的資源儲量和在關鍵地區的戰略佈局，這有助於實現成本效益和市場影響力。管理層在資本配置方面的積極策略，包括對新礦的收購和現有資產的擴張，也支持了其長期發展。然而，由於採礦業的商品性質，品牌和定價權、轉換成本以及網絡效應的護城河相對較弱。本評估基於可用的公開財務數據和公司描述，以及最近的財報電話會議內容，所有分數均為人工智慧的定性判斷，而非財務測量。值得注意的是，提供的年度和季度收入數據之間存在不一致，這限制了對某些財務指標的精確分析。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: CMOC Group Limited demonstrates strengths across several economic moat dimensions, particularly in scale and cost advantage, unique geographic assets, and operational efficiency. As a major global producer of copper and cobalt, the company benefits from its vast resource base and strategic presence in key regions, contributing to cost-effectiveness and market influence. Management's proactive capital allocation strategy, including new mine acquisitions and existing asset expansions, also supports its long-term growth. However, due to the commodity nature of the mining industry, moats related to brand and pricing power, switching costs, and network effects are relatively weaker. This assessment is based on available public financial evidence, company description, and recent earnings call transcript, with all scores representing AI qualitative judgment rather than reported financial measurements. It is noted that there are inconsistencies between provided annual and interim revenue data, which limits precise analysis of certain financial metrics.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 該公司主要經營大宗商品，其產品如銅、鈷和鉬等，通常是價格接受者。儘管公司在某些產品線中尋求高利潤，並利用貿易機會，但這更多是基於市場條件和成本控制，而非品牌溢價或獨特的定價權。其貿易業務的利潤貢獻達到最佳水平，但這反映了貿易策略而非品牌實力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The company primarily operates in commodity markets, with products like copper, cobalt, and molybdenum typically being price-takers. While the company seeks high-margin product lines and capitalizes on trading opportunities, this is driven by market conditions and cost control rather than brand premium or unique pricing power. The trading business achieved its best-ever profit contribution, but this reflects trading strategy rather than brand strength.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 該公司在採礦業運營，這是一個高度受監管的行業，需要大量的許可和執照。剛果民主共和國的鈷出口禁令以及超額利潤稅的存在，顯示了監管環境對其業務的重大影響。公司在中國的高科技企業認證也可能帶來稅收優惠。雖然沒有提及具體專利，但其在關鍵金屬領域的全球領先地位和與政府的合作關係，可能使其在複雜的監管框架下獲得相對穩定的運營優勢。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: Operating in the highly regulated mining industry, the company requires extensive permits and licenses. The cobalt export ban in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the presence of an excess profit tax demonstrate significant regulatory influence on its operations. The company's high-tech enterprise certification in China may also provide tax benefits. While specific patents are not mentioned, its leading global position in key metals and engagement with governments may provide a relatively stable operational advantage within complex regulatory frameworks.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 由於公司主要生產和銷售大宗金屬商品，這些產品通常具有高度的同質性。客戶在不同供應商之間轉換的成本預計較低，因為產品差異不大。沒有證據表明客戶在轉換供應商時會面臨顯著的財務、運營或學習成本。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: As the company primarily produces and sells bulk metal commodities, these products are generally highly homogeneous. Customers are expected to face low switching costs between different suppliers due to minimal product differentiation. There is no evidence to suggest that customers incur significant financial, operational, or learning costs when changing suppliers.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 採礦業的商業模式通常不涉及網絡效應，即產品或服務的價值不會隨著更多用戶的加入而增加。現有信息中沒有任何跡象表明該公司受益於此類效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The business model of the mining industry typically does not involve network effects, where the value of a product or service increases with more users. There is no indication in the available information that the company benefits from such effects.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 該公司是全球最大的鈷生產商之一，也是全球前十大銅礦公司之一，擁有龐大的規模和豐富的資源儲量。這種規模使其能夠實現顯著的成本優勢，例如通過優化生產流程、加強成本控制和提高營運效率來降低單位成本。公司積極尋求成本優化，並在剛果民主共和國的礦山中實現了成本下降。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company is one of the world's largest cobalt producers and among the top ten copper mining companies globally, possessing immense scale and extensive resource reserves. This scale enables significant cost advantages, such as reducing unit costs through optimized production processes, enhanced cost control, and improved operational efficiency. The company actively pursues cost optimization and has achieved cost reductions in its mines in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 該公司在全球多個國家擁有廣泛的業務，包括中國、澳洲、巴西和剛果民主共和國。其在剛果民主共和國的TFM和KFM礦山被視為世界級資源，擁有巨大的銅和鈷儲量。最近收購厄瓜多爾金礦的舉動，進一步鞏固了其在戰略性地理位置上獲取和控制稀有礦產資源的能力，這些資源難以複製。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The company has an extensive global presence with operations in multiple countries, including China, Australia, Brazil, and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Its TFM and KFM mines in the DRC are considered world-class resources with vast copper and cobalt reserves. The recent acquisition of the Ecuadorian gold mine further solidifies its ability to acquire and control rare mineral assets in strategic geographical locations, which are difficult to replicate.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 公司持續專注於提升營運效率，通過組織升級、技術創新和流程轉型來降低成本。例如，在鈷業務中通過選礦回收率的提高，以及在鉬和鎢業務中通過工藝改進和管理優化來提高回收率。這些努力直接轉化為毛利率的提升和營運成本的下降，顯示出其在有效管理和優化生產流程方面的能力。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company consistently focuses on enhancing operational efficiency, reducing costs through organizational upgrades, technological innovation, and process transformation. Examples include improved beneficiation recoveries in cobalt operations and enhanced recovery rates in molybdenum and tungsten businesses through process improvements and optimized management. These efforts directly translate into higher gross margins and lower operating costs, demonstrating its capability in effectively managing and optimizing production processes.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司展現出積極且戰略性的資本配置能力，通過多次重大海外資產收購，建立了多元化的礦產組合。管理層明確表示將繼續尋求戰略性併購，以形成銅和黃金兩大核心礦種，並擴展其他稀有金屬。這種對資源基礎的持續投資和優化，以及對股息政策的承諾，反映了其旨在創造長期股東價值的資本配置策略。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company demonstrates proactive and strategic capital allocation capabilities, having built a diversified mineral portfolio through multiple significant overseas asset acquisitions. Management explicitly states its intention to continue strategic M&A to establish copper and gold as two core mineral types, alongside expanding other minor metals. This continuous investment in and optimization of its resource base, coupled with a commitment to dividend policy, reflects a capital allocation strategy aimed at creating long-term shareholder value.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 該公司生產的許多金屬，如銅、鈷和鈮，是能源轉型和技術革命的關鍵材料，在汽車、航空航天、新能源和電子產品等新興領域有著不斷增長的需求。儘管作為大宗商品供應商，客戶忠誠度可能不高，但這些金屬在現代工業中的不可或缺性，為公司提供了抵禦需求大幅波動和技術顛覆的韌性。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Many of the metals produced by the company, such as copper, cobalt, and niobium, are critical materials for the energy transition and technological revolutions, with growing demand in emerging sectors like automotive, aerospace, new energy, and electronics. While customer loyalty might not be high for a commodity supplier, the indispensable nature of these metals in modern industries provides the company with resilience against significant demand fluctuations and technological disruption.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司在環境、社會和治理（ESG）方面表現出色，連續多年獲得高評級，並承諾在碳中和方面進行重大投資。這表明了管理層對長期可持續發展和負責任運營的承諾。其在社區發展、教育和基礎設施方面的投入，以及對員工的培訓計劃，都有助於建立良好的社會資本和運營許可，從而增強公司的長期韌性。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company demonstrates strong performance in Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) aspects, consistently receiving high ratings for several years and committing significant investments towards carbon neutrality. This indicates management's dedication to long-term sustainability and responsible operations. Its investments in community development, education, and infrastructure, along with employee training programs, contribute to building social capital and a license to operate, thereby enhancing the company's long-term resilience.

profile.description: Orient Overseas (International) Limited (OOIL), an investment holding company based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, provides extensive container transport and logistics services globally. Its reach spans Asia, Europe, Australia, North America, and other international markets. OOIL's core services encompass comprehensive supply chain management, distribution, and containerized shipping across major trade routes, including Trans-Pacific, Trans-Atlantic, Asia/Europe, Asia/Australia, and Intra-Asia. Beyond logistics, the company engages in a variety of related operations: equipment ownership and leasing, managing container depots and warehouses, and portfolio investments. It also operates terminals, owns and manages ships, offers cargo consolidation and forwarding, and functions as a liner and freight agency. Further activities include property ownership, providing corporate and trucking services, and actively operating its fleet of vessels. Additionally, OOIL delivers advanced technology solutions, such as AI and blockchain applications for digital data networks, platform design, and specialized consulting. The company is a subsidiary of Faulkner Global Holdings Limited.

report.description_zh: 東方海外（國際）有限公司（OOIL）是一家投資控股公司，總部位於香港灣仔，在全球提供廣泛的貨櫃運輸和物流服務。其業務範圍涵蓋亞洲、歐洲、澳洲、北美洲及其他國際市場。東方海外的核心服務包括全面的供應鏈管理、分銷以及橫跨主要貿易航線（如跨太平洋、跨大西洋、亞洲/歐洲、亞洲/澳洲和亞洲區內）的貨櫃運輸。除了物流業務，公司還從事多種相關營運：設備擁有和租賃、管理貨櫃堆場和倉庫、以及投資組合。它還經營碼頭、擁有和管理船舶、提供貨物集運和貨運代理服務，並作為班輪和貨運代理機構運作。其他活動包括物業擁有、提供企業和貨運服務，以及積極營運其船隊。此外，東方海外還提供先進的技術解決方案，例如用於數位資料網路、平台設計和專業諮詢的人工智慧和區塊鏈應用。該公司是 Faulkner Global Holdings Limited 的子公司。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 東方海外（國際）有限公司在全球海運和物流領域營運，展現出顯著的規模和廣泛的國際網絡。這些因素表明，由於其廣泛的營運和資產基礎，包括自有船舶和碼頭，公司可能擁有網絡效應和成本優勢。公司持續的資本支出也指向其戰略資產的發展，這些資產難以複製。然而，關於品牌定價能力、獨特的監管保護、高轉換成本或獨特的地理優勢的具體證據並未在所提供的資訊中明確說明。在沒有明確的投入資本回報率（ROIC）或加權平均資本成本（WACC）數據的情況下，難以評估其持續的資本回報，且缺乏直接證據證明管理層的誠信。所提供的評分是基於現有業務描述和財務數據的定性判斷，不代表已報告的財務衡量標準。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Orient Overseas (International) Limited operates in the global marine transportation and logistics sector, demonstrating significant scale and a broad international network. These factors suggest a potential network effect and cost advantages due to its extensive operations and asset base, including owned ships and terminals. The company's consistent capital expenditures also point to the development of strategic assets that are challenging to replicate. However, specific evidence regarding brand pricing power, unique regulatory protections, high switching costs, or distinct geographical advantages is not explicitly detailed in the provided information. Assessing sustained capital returns is limited without explicit ROIC/WACC data, and direct evidence for management integrity is not available. The scores provided are qualitative judgments based on the available business description and financial data, and do not represent reported financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 所提供的資訊描述了公司在全球範圍內的服務和技術解決方案，但沒有具體說明其品牌認知度或在競爭激烈的海運和物流行業中的定價能力。因此，無法評估其品牌是否能帶來溢價或客戶偏好。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The provided information describes the company's global reach and technology solutions, but does not offer specific details on brand recognition or pricing power within the highly competitive marine transportation and logistics industry. It is unclear if the brand allows for premium pricing or customer preference beyond service quality.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 儘管公司提供先進的技術解決方案，但沒有明確提及任何專利或獨特的監管許可證能賦予其顯著的競爭優勢。海運業的監管要求通常是行業參與者的標準營運條件。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: While the company offers advanced technology solutions, there is no explicit mention of patents or unique regulatory licenses that confer a distinct competitive advantage or barrier to entry. The nature of regulatory requirements in marine transportation is generally standard for industry participants.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司提供全面的供應鏈管理和物流服務，這可能意味著客戶因系統整合和營運複雜性而面臨一定的轉換成本。然而，所提供的資訊沒有具體說明這些成本的程度或客戶與公司系統的深度綁定。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: The company's comprehensive supply chain management and logistics services could imply some level of switching costs for clients due to integration and operational complexities. However, the provided information does not offer specific details on the extent of these costs or how deeply customers are embedded in the company's systems.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 公司廣泛的全球貨櫃運輸和物流網絡，橫跨多個大陸和主要貿易航線，顯示出強大的網絡效應。更廣泛的網絡通常能為客戶提供更高的效率、靈活性和覆蓋範圍，使其更具吸引力，也讓小型競爭對手難以複製。提及的數位資料網絡進一步支持了這一點。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The company's extensive global network for container transport and logistics, spanning multiple continents and major trade routes, suggests a strong network effect. A broader network generally offers more efficiency, flexibility, and reach for customers, making it more attractive and difficult for smaller competitors to replicate. The mention of "digital data networks" further supports this.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 公司在全球範圍內的營運、廣泛的船隊所有權和碼頭管理表明其在海運和物流方面具有顯著的規模經濟。其龐大的收入和資產基礎顯示出巨大的營運規模，這可能在採購、燃油效率和航線優化等方面提供相對於小型競爭對手的成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company's global operations, extensive fleet ownership, and management of terminals suggest significant economies of scale in marine transportation and logistics. Its substantial revenue and asset base indicate a large operational footprint, which likely provides cost advantages in areas such as procurement, fuel efficiency, and route optimization compared to smaller competitors.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 儘管公司經營碼頭並擁有船舶，但所提供的資訊並未具體說明這些資產是否位於獨特的地理位置，或者它們是否在特定市場中賦予公司自然寡頭壟斷或高效規模的優勢。描述強調的是全球覆蓋而非特定的區域主導地位。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: While the company operates terminals and owns ships, the provided information does not specify if these assets are in unique geographical locations or if they confer a natural oligopoly or efficient scale advantage in particular markets. The description highlights global reach rather than specific regional dominance.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 所提供的財務數據顯示公司有顯著的營運收入和淨收入，表明其盈利能力。然而，由於缺乏投入資本回報率（ROIC）或加權平均資本成本（WACC）等具體指標，無法定性評估公司持續的資本回報或其在產生高於資本成本的回報方面的營運效率。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The provided financial data shows significant operating income and net income, indicating profitability. However, without specific metrics like Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) or Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC), it is not possible to qualitatively assess the company's sustained capital returns or its operational efficiency in generating returns above its cost of capital.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司持續且大量的資本支出，加上其全球貨櫃運輸網絡、物流服務以及對人工智慧和區塊鏈等先進技術解決方案的投資，表明其發展了難以複製且成本高昂的戰略資產。其物理和數位基礎設施的規模構成了進入壁壘。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company's significant and ongoing capital expenditures, coupled with its global network of container transport, logistics services, and investments in advanced technology solutions like AI and blockchain, suggest the development of strategic assets that would be difficult and costly for competitors to reproduce. The scale of its physical and digital infrastructure creates a barrier to entry.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司對人工智慧和區塊鏈等先進技術解決方案的投資表明其致力於創新，並可能減輕技術顛覆的影響。然而，其核心海運業務仍然容易受到全球經濟週期和貿易政策變化帶來的重大需求中斷的影響。所提供的資訊沒有足夠的細節來評估其對這些廣泛市場力量的具體抵抗力或其客戶保留策略。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: The company's investment in advanced technology solutions like AI and blockchain indicates an effort to innovate and potentially mitigate technological disruption. However, the core marine transportation business remains exposed to significant demand disruptions from global economic cycles and trade policy changes. The provided information does not offer sufficient detail to assess its specific resistance to these broader market forces or its customer retention strategies.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司通過持續的資本支出和股息支付展現了積極的資本配置。皮奧特羅斯基分數為五，表明其財務健康和營運效率處於中等水平。然而，所提供的數據不包含具體資訊來定性評估管理層的誠信或其資本配置策略的長期持久性，超出這些財務變動的範圍。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company demonstrates active capital allocation through consistent capital expenditures and dividend payments. The Piotroski score of five suggests a moderate level of financial health and operational efficiency. profile.description: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily involved in the production and distribution of diverse glass products, such as automotive, construction, and float glass, catering to industrial and commercial requirements. Its operations are structured into three main divisions: Float Glass, Automobile Glass, and Architectural Glass. Beyond its core glass manufacturing, the company has diversified its ventures to include the production of automotive rubber and plastic components, electronic glass, and engagement in glass trading and research. Its broader portfolio encompasses offering logistics and supply chain services, operating a wind farm for electricity generation, and fabricating automatic machinery for solar and other glass-related industries. The company also holds and manages properties and car parks. Xinyi Glass serves a broad spectrum of clients, from automotive manufacturers and repair services to construction, engineering, and various wholesale and distribution businesses within the glass and related industries. The company boasts a significant global presence, distributing its products across approximately 140 countries and regions worldwide, including mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and numerous markets throughout Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas. Established in 1988, Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.

report.description_zh: 信義玻璃控股有限公司作為一家投資控股公司，主要從事汽車、建築和浮法玻璃等多種玻璃產品的生產和分銷，以滿足工業和商業需求。其業務分為三大主要部門：浮法玻璃、汽車玻璃和建築玻璃。除了核心玻璃製造業務外，公司還多元化發展，包括生產汽車橡膠和塑膠部件、電子玻璃，並參與玻璃貿易和研究。其更廣泛的業務組合包括提供物流和供應鏈服務、經營風力發電場以發電，以及為太陽能和其他玻璃相關行業製造自動化機械。公司還持有和管理物業及停車場。信義玻璃服務於廣泛的客戶群，從汽車製造商和維修服務商，到建築、工程以及玻璃及相關行業的各種批發和分銷業務。公司在全球擁有顯著的業務版圖，產品分銷至全球約一百四十個國家和地區，包括中國大陸、香港、美國、加拿大、澳洲、紐西蘭，以及亞洲、中東、歐洲、非洲和美洲的眾多市場。信義玻璃控股有限公司於一九八八年成立，總部設於香港觀塘。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 信義玻璃控股有限公司在營運效率、規模帶來的成本優勢以及審慎的資本配置方面展現出實力，這得益於其穩健的財務狀況和持續的現金流產生。公司業務多元化和全球市場佈局，顯示其具備一定的韌性。然而，其核心玻璃產品的性質可能限制了品牌驅動的定價能力和強大的網絡效應。目前沒有明確證據表明公司擁有獨特的專利或監管保護。本次評估基於現有財務數據和公司描述，各項評分均為人工智能的定性判斷，而非財務測量結果。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: Xinyi Glass Holdings Limited demonstrates strengths in operational efficiency, cost advantage derived from scale, and prudent capital allocation, supported by its robust financial health and consistent cash flow generation. The company's business diversification and global market presence suggest a degree of resilience. However, the nature of its core glass products may limit brand-driven pricing power and strong network effects. There is no explicit evidence of unique patents or regulatory protections. This assessment is based on the available financial data and company description, and the scores represent qualitative judgments by artificial intelligence, not reported financial measurements.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 該公司在全球多個國家和地區分銷產品，業務範圍廣泛，但玻璃產品的性質通常較為商品化，描述中未明確提及品牌能帶來顯著的定價優勢。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: The company distributes its products across numerous countries and regions, indicating a broad market reach. However, the nature of glass products often implies a degree of commoditization, and the description does not explicitly highlight significant brand-driven pricing power.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 公司業務涉及汽車橡膠塑膠部件、電子玻璃生產及太陽能玻璃機械製造，暗示技術能力，但未有明確證據表明擁有專利或獨特的監管許可，足以構成顯著的進入壁壘。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: The company's involvement in automotive rubber and plastic components, electronic glass production, and solar glass machinery fabrication suggests technical capabilities. However, there is no explicit evidence of patents or unique regulatory licenses that create significant barriers to entry.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 公司為汽車製造商、建築和工程企業等工業客戶提供服務，這些客戶轉換玻璃供應商可能涉及設計整合、測試和供應鏈調整等成本，從而產生一定的轉換成本。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: Serving industrial clients such as automotive manufacturers and construction businesses implies that switching glass suppliers could entail substantial costs related to design integration, testing, and supply chain modifications, contributing to customer stickiness.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 公司的業務模式主要為玻璃產品的製造和分銷，並未顯示出產品或服務的價值會隨著用戶數量增加而提升的網絡效應。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: The company's business model, primarily focused on manufacturing and distributing glass products, does not inherently demonstrate network effects where the value of its products or services increases with a growing user base.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 公司在全球多個國家和地區擁有廣泛的業務，產品線多元化，這強烈表明其在採購、生產和分銷方面具備顯著的規模經濟效益。經營風力發電場也顯示其在能源成本控制方面的策略性優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: The company's extensive global presence across numerous countries and diverse product lines strongly indicates significant economies of scale in procurement, production, and distribution. Operating a wind farm also suggests a strategic cost advantage in managing energy-intensive manufacturing processes.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 儘管公司經營風力發電場，但描述中並未指出其擁有獨特的地理優勢，足以形成自然寡頭壟斷或超越一般規模經濟的高效率。全球分銷業務也暗示市場競爭激烈，而非依賴特定地理位置的優勢。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: Although the company operates a wind farm, the description does not indicate unique geographic advantages that create a natural oligopoly or highly efficient scale beyond general economies of scale. Its global distribution suggests a competitive market rather than regional dominance due to specific locations.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 高皮得羅斯基分數顯示公司財務狀況良好且營運效率高。儘管收入和淨利潤有所波動，但公司持續產生正向的營運現金流和自由現金流，表明其在營運管理和資本配置方面表現出色。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: A high Piotroski score indicates strong financial health and operational quality. Despite some fluctuations in revenue and net income, the company consistently generates positive operating cash flow and free cash flow, demonstrating effective management of operations and capital deployment.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 公司多元化發展至風力發電場和機械製造等相關及非相關業務，顯示其在資本配置上具有策略性。持續派發股息和總債務呈下降趨勢，表明其財務管理審慎，並在回報股東與強化資產負債表之間取得平衡。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: The company's diversification into various related and unrelated ventures, such as a wind farm and machinery fabrication, suggests a strategic approach to capital deployment. Consistent dividend payments and a trend of decreasing total debt indicate prudent financial management and a balanced approach to returning capital to shareholders while strengthening the balance sheet.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 公司為汽車和建築等基礎行業提供服務，為玻璃產品帶來穩定的需求基礎。其多元化發展至電子玻璃和太陽能玻璃機械製造，顯示公司對潛在技術變革和市場需求演變具有適應策略，具備一定的抗顛覆能力。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Serving fundamental industries like automotive and construction provides a stable demand base for glass products. The company's diversification into electronic glass and machinery for solar glass indicates an adaptive strategy to potential technological shifts and evolving market demands, suggesting some resilience against disruption.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 公司自八十年代後期成立以來，擁有悠久的經營歷史，顯示其具備韌性和經驗豐富的領導團隊。高皮得羅斯基分數進一步證明其強勁的財務管理和營運品質。持續派發股息和總債務呈下降趨勢，反映管理層穩定且審慎，專注於長期價值。
m10_durability.comment_en: The company's long operating history since its establishment in the late eighties suggests resilience and experienced leadership. A high Piotroski score further reinforces strong financial management and operational quality. Consistent dividend payments and a trend of decreasing total debt reflect a stable and prudent management approach focused on long-term value.

profile.description: China Mobile Limited is a leading provider of comprehensive mobile telecommunications and associated services across Mainland China and Hong Kong. Its primary business areas encompass mobile voice and data services, broadband internet, and a broad spectrum of other offerings. By December 31, 2021, the company had established an impressive customer base, serving 957 million mobile subscribers and 240 million fixed-line broadband users. Beyond its core connectivity solutions, China Mobile delivers a diverse range of specialized services. These include telecommunications network planning, design, and consultancy; operational support for IT systems, roaming clearance, and technical assistance; as well as the creation and upkeep of value-added platforms. The company is also involved in mobile data solutions, system integration, network construction, maintenance, optimization, and training. Furthermore, it designs and sells electronic communication products and offers non-banking financial services, alongside mobile cloud research and development, call center operations, e-payment, e-commerce, internet finance, and mobile internet digital content services. China Mobile also oversees a central network and business coordination center. Established in 1997 and headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, the company was previously known as China Mobile (Hong Kong) Limited, changing its name to China Mobile Limited in May 2006. It functions as a subsidiary of China Mobile Hong Kong (BVI) Limited.

report.description_zh: 中國移動有限公司是中國大陸和香港領先的綜合移動電信及相關服務供應商。其主要業務領域涵蓋移動語音和數據服務、寬頻互聯網以及廣泛的其他產品。截至二零二一年十二月三十一日，該公司已建立龐大的客戶基礎，服務九億五千七百萬移動用戶和二億四千萬固網寬頻用戶。除了核心連接解決方案外，中國移動還提供多種專業服務。這些服務包括電信網絡規劃、設計和諮詢；IT系統的營運支援、漫遊結算和技術協助；以及增值平台的創建和維護。該公司還參與移動數據解決方案、系統整合、網絡建設、維護、優化和培訓。此外，它設計和銷售電子通訊產品，並提供非銀行金融服務，以及移動雲研究與開發、呼叫中心營運、電子支付、電子商務、互聯網金融和移動互聯網數字內容服務。中國移動還負責一個中央網絡和業務協調中心。該公司於一九九七年成立，總部位於香港中環，前身為中國移動（香港）有限公司，於二零零六年五月更名為中國移動有限公司。它是中國移動香港（英屬維爾京群島）有限公司的子公司。
report.overall_moat_verdict_zh: 中國移動憑藉其在電信行業的巨大規模、廣泛的網絡效應、顯著的監管保護以及客戶轉換成本，展現出強大的經濟護城河。其龐大的用戶基礎和基礎設施難以複製，並持續產生穩定的現金流。然而，對於管理層誠信和具體資本配置策略的定性資訊有限。本評估中的分數為人工智慧的定性判斷，而非財務測量結果，且基於截至二零二六年第二季度的可用財務數據和公司描述。
report.overall_moat_verdict_en: China Mobile demonstrates a strong economic moat, primarily driven by its immense scale in the telecommunications industry, extensive network effects, significant regulatory protection, and customer switching costs. Its vast subscriber base and infrastructure are difficult to replicate, and it consistently generates robust cash flows. However, qualitative information regarding management integrity and specific capital allocation strategies is limited. The scores in this assessment are AI qualitative judgments, not financial measurements, and are based on available financial data and company description up to the second quarter of two thousand twenty-six.

m1_brand_pricing.comment_zh: 中國移動在市場上擁有龐大的客戶基礎和領先地位，顯示其品牌具有一定的知名度。儘管電信業常受監管影響定價，但其營運規模和用戶數量暗示了品牌忠誠度和市場影響力。
m1_brand_pricing.comment_en: China Mobile's extensive customer base and leading position in its markets suggest a recognized brand. While the telecommunications sector is often subject to regulatory oversight that can influence pricing, the sheer scale of its operations and subscriber numbers imply a degree of brand loyalty and market influence.

m2_patents_regulatory.comment_zh: 作為其營運地區的主導電信服務供應商，中國移動很可能擁有重要的監管許可和批准。該行業的性質為新競爭者設置了高進入壁壘，提供了保護性優勢。
m2_patents_regulatory.comment_en: As a dominant telecommunications provider in its operating regions, China Mobile likely benefits from substantial regulatory licenses and approvals. The nature of the industry creates high barriers to entry for new competitors, providing a protective advantage.

m3_high_switching_costs.comment_zh: 對於擁有龐大用戶基礎的電信供應商而言，客戶在更換服務時常面臨一些不便和潛在成本，例如號碼攜帶流程或合約義務。這可以為現有用戶創造一定的黏性。
m3_high_switching_costs.comment_en: For a telecommunications provider with a vast subscriber base, customers often face some inconvenience and potential costs when changing services, such as number portability processes or contract obligations. This can create a degree of stickiness for existing users.

m4_network_effects.comment_zh: 憑藉其龐大的移動和寬頻用戶數量，中國移動顯著受益於網絡效應。隨著越來越多的個人和企業連接到其廣泛的網絡，其通訊服務的實用性和吸引力也隨之增加。
m4_network_effects.comment_en: With an exceptionally large number of mobile and broadband subscribers, China Mobile benefits significantly from network effects. The utility and attractiveness of its communication services increase as more individuals and businesses connect to its extensive network.

m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_zh: 中國移動作為領先供應商，擁有龐大的用戶基礎，使其能夠實現顯著的規模經濟。這在網絡基礎設施開發、設備採購以及將營運費用分攤到廣大客戶群方面帶來了成本優勢。
m5_cost_advantage_scale.comment_en: China Mobile's position as a leading provider with an immense subscriber base allows it to achieve significant economies of scale. This translates into cost advantages in areas such as network infrastructure development, equipment purchasing, and spreading operational expenses over a vast customer pool.

m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_zh: 電信業需要對地理特定基礎設施進行大量投資。中國移動在其營運區域的廣泛網絡代表著一項重要的資產，潛在競爭者難以複製，這有助於形成高效規模和自然寡頭壟斷。
m6_unique_geography_assets.comment_en: The telecommunications industry requires substantial investment in geographically specific infrastructure. China Mobile's extensive network across its operating regions represents a significant asset that is costly and difficult for potential competitors to duplicate, contributing to an efficient scale and a natural oligopoly.

m7_operational_efficiency.comment_zh: 該公司在可用的年度期間持續產生可觀的淨收入和正自由現金流。這種財務表現表明其營運管理有效，並有能力從資本投資中產生持續回報。
m7_operational_efficiency.comment_en: The company consistently generates substantial net income and positive free cash flow across the available annual periods. This financial performance indicates effective operational management and a capacity to generate sustained returns from its capital investments.

m8_capital_allocation.comment_zh: 中國移動的全面電信網絡和多元化服務組合，多年來建立而成，構成了競爭對手極難複製的戰略資產。對此基礎設施的持續投資和維護，進一步鞏固了其不可複製性。
m8_capital_allocation.comment_en: China Mobile's comprehensive telecommunications network and diverse service portfolio, built over many years, constitute strategic assets that are highly challenging for competitors to reproduce. The continuous investment in and maintenance of this infrastructure reinforces its irreproducibility.

m9_customer_retention.comment_zh: 作為提供基本移動和寬頻服務的公司，中國移動享有相對穩定的需求。其龐大的客戶基礎和對網絡升級的持續投資，使其能夠很好地適應技術進步，並在潛在的顛覆面前保持客戶忠誠度。
m9_customer_retention.comment_en: Providing essential mobile and broadband services, China Mobile enjoys relatively stable demand. Its vast customer base and ongoing investments in network upgrades position it well to adapt to technological advancements and maintain customer loyalty against potential disruptions.

m10_durability.comment_zh: 所提供的財務數據和公司描述未能提供足夠的定性資訊，以評估管理層的誠信或除了觀察到的財務結果之外的具體資本配置策略。
m10_durability.comment_en: The provided financial data and company description do not offer sufficient qualitative information to assess management integrity or specific details regarding capital allocation strategies beyond the observed financial outcomes.

profile.description: Power Assets Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company primarily engaged in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity across Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Australia, Mainland China, and other international regions. The company's energy portfolio is diverse, sourcing power from thermal, renewable, and waste materials. Beyond its core electricity business, Power Assets also handles the transmission and distribution of oil and gas, manages property and deposits, and offers various services including consulting, investment, trust administration, and management. Its substantial infrastructure includes a total generation capacity of 1,064 MW from renewable energy/waste, 5,214 MW from gas-fired plants, and 3,815 MW from coal/oil-fired facilities. The company also oversees an extensive network comprising 114,200 km of gas/oil pipelines and 402,500 km of power networks, collectively serving over 19.3 million customers. Established in 1889 and based in Central, Hong Kong, the company was rebranded as Power Assets Holdings Limited in February 2011, having previously been known as Hongkong Electric Holdings Limited.
